patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the short vibrations TikTok plays on its own taps and gestures, the long press buzz included. Your keyboard and your phone's own haptics stay. Off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without their slide. Swipes inside a screen still follow your finger. Off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Draws TikTok's text in your device's font instead of TikTok Sans. The icons, the gift animations and the @ and # glyphs keep their own fonts. A second switch draws every emoji with your device's emoji font instead of filling in the newest ones with Google's. Both are off until you turn them on. Restart TikTok after changing them. Switches: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Disable Content Capture
patches_added.description: Stops Chromium from streaming on-screen page text and URLs to the Android ContentCapture system service (Android System Intelligence).

patches_added.name: Tab Group Close Selection
patches_added.description: When closing the active tab in a tab group, selects the previous tab in the same group instead of jumping outside the group.

patches_modified.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, Chromium UMA metrics, and Variations seed fetching.

patches_modified.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches_modified.name: Brave Origin
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches_modified.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches_modified.name: Clean New Tab Page
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored wallpaper images, Brave News/Today feeds, marketing widgets, and promo cards from the New Tab Page.

patches_modified.name: Clean Share URL
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, igshid, si, msclkid) when sharing or copying links.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Battery Status API (navigator.getBattery) to prevent cross-site device fingerprinting and drops OS battery change broadcasts.

patches_modified.name: Disable Tab Auto-Minimization
patches_modified.description: Prevents Brave from minimizing active tabs to the background and forcing a New Tab Page when returning to the browser after inactivity.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Sensor Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes motion, ambient, and orientation sensor providers to prevent hardware fingerprinting and tracking via Generic Sensor APIs.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches_modified.name: Suppress In-App Promos & Surveys
patches_modified.description: Suppresses intrusive in-app rating surveys, Play Store review prompts, and marketing promo popups (YouTube promo, ad-free callouts, and Brave Ads onboarding).

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Services Integration
patches_modified.description: Makes Gboard's Google Play services availability check always report SERVICE_DISABLED, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, account sync, Google Help feedback) are skipped at the source instead of being attempted. Note: Disables Gboard's inline Google Translate tool, which relies on Play Services Cronet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes Gboard's Google Play services availability check always report SERVICE_DISABLED, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, account sync, Google Help feedback) are skipped at the source instead of being attempted.

patches_modified.name: Gboard Enhancements
patches_modified.description: Master customization suite bundling in-app toggleable features (AMOLED Pure Black theme, zero bottom inset, independent keyboard vibration, force incognito, voice typing in incognito, clipboard in incognito, clipboard retention, top toolbar icons count, cursor trackpad, and smart flags) managed directly from a top-level Morphe Patches category in Gboard Settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Master customization suite bundling in-app toggleable features (AMOLED Pure Black theme, zero bottom inset, independent keyboard vibration, force incognito, voice typing in incognito, clipboard retention, top toolbar icons count, cursor trackpad, and smart flags) managed directly from a top-level Morphe Patches category in Gboard Settings.

patches_added.name: Skip Welcome Dialog
patches_added.description: Suppresses the first-launch About/privacy dialog by applying the app's own accept action silently. The About entry in the menu keeps working.

patches_added.name: Camera & Microphone Indicator
patches_added.description: Shows a corner mark while TikTok holds camera/mic open.

patches_added.name: Enable Live Search
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_added.name: Feed Content Filter
patches_added.description: Hides stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges from feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide Promotional Content
patches_added.description: Filters videos disclosing branded/paid-promotional content (Contenido Promocional tag) from For You, Following and Friends feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide Suggested Accounts
patches_added.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile headers and inbox surfaces.

patches_added.name: Non-Personalized Search
patches_added.description: Forces TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of the saved account choice.

patches_added.name: Remember Clear Display
patches_added.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos and re-applies it when new videos start.

patches_added.name: Show Author Region
patches_added.description: Displays the creator's country or region code next to their username in video author info across feeds and deep-linked detail views.

patches_added.name: Skip Content Warnings
patches_added.description: Bypasses and clears sensitive content warnings, graphic media blur overlays, and age gates on feed videos.

patches_added.name: TikTok Privacy Permissions Stripper
patches_added.description: Selectively strips sensitive privacy, sensor, hardware, and tracking permissions from AndroidManifest.xml via configurable boolean toggles.

patches_added.name: Video Fit
patches_added.description: Adjusts video display aspect ratio across feeds and story cells: 'fit' ensures the entire video is visible without cropping, or 'fill' expands the video to fill the screen.

patches_added.name: Voice & Speech Engine De-bloat
patches_added.description: Strips on-device voice recognition and speech synthesis engines (libspeechspg.so, libspeechsdk.so) and their loader stubs (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so) to save APK space. Breaks voice search (microphone button), voice input, and editor text-to-speech/sing features.

patches_modified.name: Clean Share URL
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links, with optional custom host redirection.
patches_modified.previous_description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links.

patches_modified.name: Comment Customizer
patches_modified.description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, hiding comment quick actions, hiding in-comment surveys and feedback cards, hiding profile photo story rings, enabling voice comments, automatic comment translation, fixing silent comment drops, and hiding comment popup ads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, hiding comment quick actions, hiding in-comment surveys and feedback cards, hiding profile photo story rings, enabling voice comments, and automatic comment translation.

patches_modified.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions, contacts queries, package inventory inspection, location hardware tracking, advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions (contacts sync, location tracking, nearby devices), advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.

patches_modified.name: Direct Message Declutter
patches_modified.description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, sticker reply suggestions, and the typing-triggered sticker strip.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, and sticker reply suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Disable Double Tap to Like
patches_modified.description: Disables double tap like in the feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables the double tap gesture to like videos in the feed, preventing accidental likes while scrolling or pausing. Videos can still be liked using the like button.

patches_modified.name: Disable Feed Long-Press Actions
patches_modified.description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis, with optional long-press video body redirection.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis.

patches_modified.name: Feed Interface Declutter
patches_modified.description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, interest feedback pills, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.

patches_modified.name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), DM voice/video call engine (libvoip.so), live RTM messaging (librtmglobal.so) and live base runtime (libbase_live.so), plus live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint. Breaks live viewing/broadcasting and direct message calls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), and live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint.

patches_modified.name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader
patches_modified.description: Unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos inside the Share panel, and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.

patches_modified.name: Playback Speed Persistence
patches_modified.description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts, and optionally enables the native hold-and-slide 2x speed lock gesture.
patches_modified.previous_description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts.

patches_modified.name: SIM Region Selector
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code, operator numeric codes, operator names, and cell identity MCC/MNC to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.
patches_modified.previous_description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.

patches_modified.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, camera dynamic features, upload video encoders, on-device AI runtimes (LiteRT), and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.
patches_modified.previous_description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Video Quality Governor
patches_modified.description: Caps video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data. Download quality is controlled separately by the Media Usability patch (downloadQuality).
patches_modified.previous_description: Caps video playback and download resolutions (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) independently to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches_added.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets screenshots and screen recordings work wherever Instagram blocks them, like disappearing photos and videos in your chats.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on a call button doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't. Continue goes ahead and Cancel doesn't. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so a stray pull keeps what's on screen. Refresh goes ahead, and Cancel stops the spinner. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_modified.name: Change the like animation
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays an animation you pick, from the ones Instagram made for Instagram Rings creators, in the heart that pops up when you double tap a post. Its switch, under Reels, starts off.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Instagram's checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Once it's in, going back to an unpatched Instagram means uninstalling first, which deletes Instagram's data on your phone, and later HushGram builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity and the comment bar on reposts. Each one has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity with the comment preview, and the comment bar under a reposted reel. Each part has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Clear the media cache
patches_modified.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.
patches_modified.previous_description: Once Instagram's cache holds more than 500 MB of images and videos, deletes the images when it goes to the background and the videos the next time it starts. A Clear now row shows what it freed. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds optional Copy and Copy username actions to the common comment menu. Copy keeps the original text with its line breaks, and Copy username copies the commenter's username. Their switches start off.

patches_modified.name: Data saver
patches_modified.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Loads photos at a smaller size and starts videos, reels and stories at the lowest quality, on mobile data or on every network. It works through Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it brings both along.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from sending usage reports and crash reports to Instagram and Facebook. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens. Restart Instagram after you change it. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends Instagram's usage events and crash reports to an address on your phone that refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's servers. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens, which would come back on every start without those events. Restart Instagram after changing the switch.

patches_modified.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps Instagram from noticing your screenshots, so whoever sent you a disappearing photo or video isn't told you took one.

patches_modified.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_modified.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps what you open from search out of Recent, both in the app and on Instagram's side. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops telling Instagram which reels you watched and how far into them you got. It's used to rank your Reels, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark. Turn on Download cover for a row that saves the still picture shown before the reel plays.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. A video saves at the Download quality you set, a photo at its largest size. A photo story with music offers Download as video and Download as photo.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover and a Details row with the post's time and poster. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video, and of a carousel showing a video. Videos save at the Download quality you set, without Instagram's watermark. A second switch does the same for photo posts, and a third adds Download cover, which saves the still picture a video shows before it plays. Another adds Details, with the post's time, who posted it, its media ID and buttons that copy its direct link, the username and the caption.

patches_modified.name: Download voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an optional Save to the menu you get by holding a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Emoji style
patches_modified.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
patches_modified.previous_description: Draws every emoji in Google's style, from the emoji font Instagram gets through Google Play services, instead of your phone's own style. Its switch, under Layout, starts off, and a change shows fully after Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Full resolution photos
patches_modified.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Loads photos in your feed, in carousels and in posts you open at the largest size Instagram sends rather than the size it picks for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on a phone under 1440 pixels wide. It can use more data.

patches_modified.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_modified.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.
patches_modified.previous_description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group per type with a second switch, so they don't fill the notification shade. A group of two or more shows how many it holds. Tapping a notification still opens what it did.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instagram is told your account doesn't have Instants, its no-edit camera for friends.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch, and some start on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Meta AI.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes Meta AI out of the search bars, in the Search tab and at the top of your messages, so they search the plain way, drops the Ask a follow-up bar under search results and Meta AI's buttons in Home's top bar and the message composer, hides its optional row in your inbox, and removes Meta AI's posts from your home feed. It can also take About this reel, or only its Ask Meta AI box, out of a reel's More menu, and Meta AI's target out of the share sheet. Search, posts, About this reel, Ask Meta AI and the share sheet have separate switches, and the last three start off. The search switch applies after Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the rows of suggested reels between posts in your home feed, and the other units that open the Reels viewer from there. A reel someone you follow posts stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories. Instagram is told the ad didn't go in, so no gap is left where it would have been.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off the posts in your feed, with a switch under Comments that starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet. You can still start a group from your messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the New group button away from beside the share sheet's search bar, and the button that sends to the people you picked as one group, so they get it one by one. You can still start a group from your messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and the Add to highlight list on your stories stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Leaves out the cards of people and creators to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts, posts and follower lists stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and follower lists stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide all videos, photos or carousels. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the posts and reels from accounts you don't follow that Instagram puts in your home feed as Suggested for you, the rows of accounts, shops and hashtags it suggests you follow, the posts and accounts from Threads it mixes in, the surveys it asks you to fill in, and its shopping rows. Each has its own switch. Posts from accounts you follow stay, unless you turn on Hide videos, Hide photos or Hide carousels, which start off and take every post of that type out of Home.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, or the whole row. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the stories from accounts you don't follow, and the accounts Instagram suggests, from the row of stories at the top of Home. More switches, off to start, take out rewinds, memories and recaps, stop the row's stories loading, or take the whole row away.

patches_modified.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_modified.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an off-by-default switch so the people you're chatting with don't see when you're typing. Unlike turning off the typing indicator in Instagram's settings, you still see when they're typing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches_modified.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties the grid of posts and reels under the Search tab's bar. Search, your recent searches and search results stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and a start or a notification meant for it opens Home. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open, and a change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Repost button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still sends a post or reel to someone.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Share button and its count off the posts in your feed and off reels, with a switch under Sharing that starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Threads button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The menu and the other buttons stay. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide the home feed
patches_modified.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows the stories row and nothing under it. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the notes row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the row of notes off the top of your messages, the Map bubble in it too. Your chats, search and requests stay.

patches_modified.name: HushGram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by pressing and holding Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds HushGram settings to Instagram. Long-press Instagram's launcher icon and pick HushGram settings, or tap HushGram settings at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity. You can also choose one tab whose long press opens HushGram. That choice starts off. Turn features on or off, pause HushGram and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Once you turn on Instagram's auto scroll in Reels, it stays on after Instagram restarts or you leave Reels, until you turn it off yourself.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps Instagram's seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Ads keep Instagram's own rules.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats, as if they'd been sent with Keep in chat, so they don't disappear after you open them. Turning it on or off reaches the ones already loaded once the chat loads again.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock (hold its edge, then slide down) and the next reels play at 2x too, until you slide the lock off, hold the edge and let go, or Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Lock your messages
patches_modified.description: Covers your inbox and chats, or all of Instagram, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that keep your inbox and chats, or all of Instagram, covered until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. They lock again when you leave Instagram or after the time you pick, and message notifications say only that a message came.

patches_modified.name: Loop a story
patches_modified.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: A story plays again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on.

patches_modified.name: Open developer options
patches_modified.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where you can change its hidden settings. A wrong change can break parts of Instagram until you reset it. On once you patch it in. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Developer.
patches_modified.previous_description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where its server flags (MetaConfig and quick experiments) can be looked at and overridden on your phone. A wrong flag can break parts of Instagram until you reset it there.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens a web link you tap in your default browser instead of Instagram's in-app browser, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram and other Meta pages, and ads, still open in the app.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Menus and buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Instagram's dark mode uses pure black instead of its near-black gray, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus, sheets and buttons keep their own grays so they stay easy to see. Chosen when you patch, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an off-by-default switch so opening a chat doesn't tell people you've seen their messages. Unlike turning off read receipts in Instagram's settings, you still see when they've seen yours. Instagram's Mark as read still lets them know, whether you long press one chat or pick several. View-once photos and videos have their own patch.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Updates.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build doesn't update on its own, so without this it would stop working after a few weeks.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Instagram can't read your phone's advertising ID or tell Android's ad services which ads you saw or tapped. The permissions for them are taken out of the build, so Google Play services hands Instagram a string of zeros in place of the ID.

patches_modified.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes away the empty room Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there, on a phone that hides its navigation bar and in a pop-up window. A change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets Instagram's own signature checks pass on a re-signed build, so the parts of the app that check who signed it keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key open from Instagram too, and Instagram trusts them when they share to it or ask it for your sign-in. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes stkn, igsh, utm_source and Instagram's other tracking keys off the links you copy or share, and opens a bio link without going through Instagram's click tracker. The post, reel, story or profile a link opens stays the same.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo, saving the largest size Instagram sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an optional Save action to the common comment menu when a comment has a photo of its own. It saves the largest size Instagram sent, the same way Download saves a post's photo.

patches_modified.name: Save profile picture
patches_modified.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds optional Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio rows to the menu on someone's profile. Save keeps their picture at the largest size Instagram has, View opens it full screen with pinch zoom, and the copy rows copy the text exactly. Their switches start off.

patches_modified.name: See who a story mentions
patches_modified.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a pill under the name in a story's header saying how many accounts the story mentions, even when the mention sticker is hidden or off screen. Tap it for a list with each account's picture, name and username, and tap one to open their profile. A story with no mentions gets no pill.

patches_modified.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, under it in your feed, and the date and time of each comment, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the date and time a story was posted in its header, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under its switch can show the time left before the story expires, or only the time it went up. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any, or as a chip under their counts that also says Following each other. A second switch, off to start, marks the accounts on your own Following list that don't follow you back.

patches_modified.name: Spoof location
patches_modified.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Tells Instagram the phone is at a place you set in HushGram's settings, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places.

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following
patches_modified.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow. Tap Following at the top to switch to For you, and Home remembers your pick. A second switch, off to start, takes For you out of Home. A change to either shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps Instagram from crashing or freezing on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an x86 Chromebook or an emulator, by skipping the one code protection step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before.

patches_modified.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping for 15 minutes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping until you've had a 15 minute break.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Instagram's timing.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button and every other way into the camera still work.

patches_modified.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still changes tabs, and Reels still scroll up and down.

patches_modified.name: Story ring size
patches_modified.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger. Nothing changes until you pick a size. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on the screen, or larger. Pick the size in HushGram's settings.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. Feed videos show a play button, the way they do when Instagram saves mobile data.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps HDR photos and reels from brightening the screen above everything else, with a switch under Playback that starts off.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. Switches for comments and chat messages start off. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.

patches_modified.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches_modified.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an off-by-default switch to hold back the opened receipt for view-once photos and videos in messages. Ordinary chat and voice receipts keep Instagram's behavior.

patches_modified.name: View live anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. A live that ends can keep looking live until you leave it. Your own lives still count their viewers.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Holds story-view reports while its switch is on. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep showing as new. An optional Mark as seen button selects stories to send.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches_added.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets screenshots and screen recordings work wherever Instagram blocks them, like disappearing photos and videos in your chats.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on a call button doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't. Continue goes ahead and Cancel doesn't. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so a stray pull keeps what's on screen. Refresh goes ahead, and Cancel stops the spinner. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_modified.name: Change the like animation
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays an animation you pick, from the ones Instagram made for Instagram Rings creators, in the heart that pops up when you double tap a post. Its switch, under Reels, starts off.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Instagram's checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Once it's in, going back to an unpatched Instagram means uninstalling first, which deletes Instagram's data on your phone, and later HushGram builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity and the comment bar on reposts. Each one has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity with the comment preview, and the comment bar under a reposted reel. Each part has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Clear the media cache
patches_modified.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.
patches_modified.previous_description: Once Instagram's cache holds more than 500 MB of images and videos, deletes the images when it goes to the background and the videos the next time it starts. A Clear now row shows what it freed. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds optional Copy and Copy username actions to the common comment menu. Copy keeps the original text with its line breaks, and Copy username copies the commenter's username. Their switches start off.

patches_modified.name: Data saver
patches_modified.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Loads photos at a smaller size and starts videos, reels and stories at the lowest quality, on mobile data or on every network. It works through Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it brings both along.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from sending usage reports and crash reports to Instagram and Facebook. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens. Restart Instagram after you change it. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends Instagram's usage events and crash reports to an address on your phone that refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's servers. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens, which would come back on every start without those events. Restart Instagram after changing the switch.

patches_modified.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps Instagram from noticing your screenshots, so whoever sent you a disappearing photo or video isn't told you took one.

patches_modified.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_modified.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps what you open from search out of Recent, both in the app and on Instagram's side. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops telling Instagram which reels you watched and how far into them you got. It's used to rank your Reels, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark. Turn on Download cover for a row that saves the still picture shown before the reel plays.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. A video saves at the Download quality you set, a photo at its largest size. A photo story with music offers Download as video and Download as photo.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover and a Details row with the post's time and poster. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video, and of a carousel showing a video. Videos save at the Download quality you set, without Instagram's watermark. A second switch does the same for photo posts, and a third adds Download cover, which saves the still picture a video shows before it plays. Another adds Details, with the post's time, who posted it, its media ID and buttons that copy its direct link, the username and the caption.

patches_modified.name: Download voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an optional Save to the menu you get by holding a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Emoji style
patches_modified.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
patches_modified.previous_description: Draws every emoji in Google's style, from the emoji font Instagram gets through Google Play services, instead of your phone's own style. Its switch, under Layout, starts off, and a change shows fully after Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Full resolution photos
patches_modified.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Loads photos in your feed, in carousels and in posts you open at the largest size Instagram sends rather than the size it picks for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on a phone under 1440 pixels wide. It can use more data.

patches_modified.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_modified.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.
patches_modified.previous_description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group per type with a second switch, so they don't fill the notification shade. A group of two or more shows how many it holds. Tapping a notification still opens what it did.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instagram is told your account doesn't have Instants, its no-edit camera for friends.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch, and some start on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Meta AI.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes Meta AI out of the search bars, in the Search tab and at the top of your messages, so they search the plain way, drops the Ask a follow-up bar under search results and Meta AI's buttons in Home's top bar and the message composer, hides its optional row in your inbox, and removes Meta AI's posts from your home feed. It can also take About this reel, or only its Ask Meta AI box, out of a reel's More menu, and Meta AI's target out of the share sheet. Search, posts, About this reel, Ask Meta AI and the share sheet have separate switches, and the last three start off. The search switch applies after Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the rows of suggested reels between posts in your home feed, and the other units that open the Reels viewer from there. A reel someone you follow posts stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories. Instagram is told the ad didn't go in, so no gap is left where it would have been.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off the posts in your feed, with a switch under Comments that starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet. You can still start a group from your messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the New group button away from beside the share sheet's search bar, and the button that sends to the people you picked as one group, so they get it one by one. You can still start a group from your messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and the Add to highlight list on your stories stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Leaves out the cards of people and creators to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts, posts and follower lists stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and follower lists stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide all videos, photos or carousels. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the posts and reels from accounts you don't follow that Instagram puts in your home feed as Suggested for you, the rows of accounts, shops and hashtags it suggests you follow, the posts and accounts from Threads it mixes in, the surveys it asks you to fill in, and its shopping rows. Each has its own switch. Posts from accounts you follow stay, unless you turn on Hide videos, Hide photos or Hide carousels, which start off and take every post of that type out of Home.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, or the whole row. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the stories from accounts you don't follow, and the accounts Instagram suggests, from the row of stories at the top of Home. More switches, off to start, take out rewinds, memories and recaps, stop the row's stories loading, or take the whole row away.

patches_modified.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_modified.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an off-by-default switch so the people you're chatting with don't see when you're typing. Unlike turning off the typing indicator in Instagram's settings, you still see when they're typing.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches_modified.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties the grid of posts and reels under the Search tab's bar. Search, your recent searches and search results stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and a start or a notification meant for it opens Home. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open, and a change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Repost button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still sends a post or reel to someone.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Share button and its count off the posts in your feed and off reels, with a switch under Sharing that starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Threads button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The menu and the other buttons stay. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide the home feed
patches_modified.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows the stories row and nothing under it. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the notes row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the row of notes off the top of your messages, the Map bubble in it too. Your chats, search and requests stay.

patches_modified.name: HushGram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by pressing and holding Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds HushGram settings to Instagram. Long-press Instagram's launcher icon and pick HushGram settings, or tap HushGram settings at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity. You can also choose one tab whose long press opens HushGram. That choice starts off. Turn features on or off, pause HushGram and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Once you turn on Instagram's auto scroll in Reels, it stays on after Instagram restarts or you leave Reels, until you turn it off yourself.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps Instagram's seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Ads keep Instagram's own rules.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats, as if they'd been sent with Keep in chat, so they don't disappear after you open them. Turning it on or off reaches the ones already loaded once the chat loads again.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock (hold its edge, then slide down) and the next reels play at 2x too, until you slide the lock off, hold the edge and let go, or Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Lock your messages
