patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hide the search button at the top right of video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes floating promotional badges from the feed and can hide the rewards shortcut on Profile. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen and App.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, Bulletin board, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually, along with the banner that invites you to start a group chat, and switches for the call buttons, sticker suggestions and suggested replies inside a chat and for a message's double tap heart and swipe to reply. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the stories tray at the top of the Inbox and restores it immediately when the switch is turned off. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders. TikTok's server decides what goes in that row, so the checklist offers the ones it has sent to your phone, and you can also type names. Restart TikTok after a change. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone. A separate switch hides the search rewards banner and coin counter some regions get. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages, and collapses every other People you may like card: the profile header, the Friends tab and the feed. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties the menu that opens on pressing and holding TikTok's icon on the home screen. The entries are built while the app runs rather than declared in it, and TikTok only rewrites them when it notices a difference, so this removes what is already published and answers the handover that would publish more. Turning it off asks TikTok to build them again. Tapping the icon still opens the app, and a shortcut pinned to a home screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Notes in the diagnostic report when TikTok's account safety check decides to show a verification puzzle. It doesn't hide anything, so it's only useful for research. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.
patches_modified.previous_description: Records TikTok's BdTuring risk-control decisions through the shared CAPTCHA gate. All verification dialogs remain visible because no browsing scene has been validated. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards, Footnotes and the status bar, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search. The status bar can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. One more takes the Add comment bar off those opened videos so they fill the screen, and another clears the close button, progress bar and pause and speed buttons Clear display leaves at the bottom. Swipe for brightness and volume turns a vertical drag along the left or right edge of a video into screen brightness, volume or, with Playback speed in the bundle, the video's speed. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the status bar.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables TikTok's own hold, pull down and release gesture to lock the hold speed, 2x unless Playback speed sets another. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps TikTok's JavaScript bridge off external pages in its in-app browser while leaving Activity center, Watch history, shop checkout and CAPTCHA working. The switch is off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends one message a day to each person you pick, at a time you pick, so message streaks with them keep going on days you don't open TikTok. The message goes through TikTok's own notification reply. Adds the exact alarm and start at boot permissions the daily alarm needs. Off until you turn it on: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps TikTok's own background play on, whatever its server says, so the video you're watching keeps playing after you leave the app or turn the screen off, and TikTok's media notification pauses and resumes it. It also covers photo posts and the videos on your own profile, private ones included, which TikTok leaves out. A feed video plays to its end, because TikTok doesn't loop or move on in the feed while it's in the background, and another app's sound still pauses it. TikTok's own background play switch in the long-press menu stays on while this is on. Off by default. Restart TikTok after changing it. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that plays the audio on videos TikTok silenced because their sound was pulled for copyright or in your region. TikTok may still label the sound as unavailable. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps the Favorites tab on your profile when TikTok's server puts the account into an experiment that empties it. Two people saw that after patching: the tab was there and the saved videos were not. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown, and can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that stops a LIVE in the feed counting down and taking you into the room on its own, so you stay in the feed until you tap it, and one that shows a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of TikTok's rounded one. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Lift text length limits
patches_modified.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that lets comments, repost notes and your bio run past the length TikTok's app stops at. TikTok's servers can still turn down a long one. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. It has no switch, so only patching again without it undoes it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate. Videos may start buffering later. Push setup stays on unless Skip push setup is enabled in the patch options.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Answers TikTok's location requests with nothing: the last known location comes back empty and update requests never fire. The SIM and region spoof change the locale and timezone, not the coordinates. This patch stops the coordinates. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video do something else, like open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, copy the link to the video or its sound, look the sound up on YouTube Music, set a sleep timer that stops the video and closes TikTok when it runs out, save the frame on screen as a JPEG, or save the video's cover. It can also turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward, and make a long press on Comment, Share or Favorites play at the hold speed instead of opening TikTok's menu. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Answers TikTok's own checks of how it was signed and installed the way the Play Store app would. Its signature hash reads as TikTok's certificate and its installer reads as the Play Store, or another store you pick. For a follow or a like that undoes itself on a refresh on a patched build. TikTok can also read the APK from native code, which no patch reaches, so it may not be enough on its own. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Mute feed videos
patches_modified.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a movable button that mutes feed videos without touching the phone's volume, and a switch that does the same. The button starts off until you turn on Show the mute button on videos. It also shows on a video opened from a profile, a hashtag or a sound, and mutes that one too. While muted, music from another app keeps playing, and DMs, stories and LIVE keep their sound. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback, and Feed screen for the button.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends TikTok's own network stack, which carries the feed, search, comments and the rest of its API, through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy you set, along with plain Java connections. Videos and LIVE streams load through TikTok's player, which connects on its own, so they stay direct. TikTok's network stack can't sign in to a proxy, so a user name and password only reach the Java connections. Other apps aren't affected. Off by default. Restart after changing. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Counts the requests TikTok's own API client sends, by domain and kind, and adds them to the diagnostic export. Video and image downloads and other companies' SDKs keep their own connections and aren't counted. Nothing about the requests is changed.

patches_modified.name: Not interested button
patches_modified.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a movable button that tells TikTok you aren't interested in the current video. It hides while comments are open. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. The follower switch drops the notification before Android is asked to post it, so nothing else in the drawer is affected. A third switch, off by default, turns push notifications off altogether. TikTok's push service doesn't start and nothing it posts reaches the drawer, apart from ongoing ones like media controls. It can't hold your phone awake either. You won't hear about new messages until you open TikTok, and turning the switch off sets push up again the next time TikTok starts. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that keeps the video you're watching playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, with a button to pause it. Works in the feed and on videos opened from a profile, search or a sound. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays the standard version of videos that also come in HDR, so the screen doesn't jump to full brightness when one starts. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Selects the lowest, highest or a target video quality for playback, adaptive streams included. A second choice caps quality on mobile data and only ever lowers it. Download quality has its own setting. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remembers playback speed or applies a default to each new video, with custom menu choices up to 3x and your own speed for the hold gesture. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays the H.264 version of a video when TikTok offers one beside its HEVC and ByteVC2 versions, for phones that stutter or run hot playing those. A video with no H.264 version plays as before. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.
patches_modified.previous_description: Matches locale, timezone and native region getters to the SIM preset, with separate switches for the store region (experimental) and the region fields sent with each request. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remembers clear display between videos, or enters it automatically after a chosen delay. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties TikTok's co-host (link-mic) and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. In LIVE the red and blue battle score bar and the co-host guests' names can go missing, and co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working. The APK gets about 3 MB smaller.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that take the story ring and the pulsing LIVE ring off profile pictures, so a tap opens the profile. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's built-in AI model files, payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 19 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA and Microblink card-scanning assets, the Pitaya AI model libraries and the Python runtime they run on, the live-cast dynamic feature, and the ART log monitor probe. Saves about 19 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's camera, editing and effects files, saving about 40 MB of storage. The catch: the Create tab and every recording, editing and effects tool stop working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. The Create tab and all recording, editing and effects tools stop working. Saves about 40 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties the TikTok language bundles you leave out of Languages to keep, always keeping English. It keeps every language until you list the ones you want, so picking every patch removes none. Listed codes are checked before any file changes. Keeping only English saves about 26 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: With diagnostic logging on, records a repost request, TikTok's answer, and the next repost-list read without recording the video's ID or note.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. A second switch, off by default, keeps TikTok's phone benchmark from starting in a background process of its own. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Run beside the store app
patches_modified.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets a TikTok copy renamed with Morphe's Clone app patch sign in while the store app stays installed. Select it together with Clone app. When the copy registers your phone with TikTok it gives TikTok's own package name, because TikTok's servers don't hand out a device ID for a name they don't know and signing in fails without one. Its settings shared between TikTok's processes, its live wallpaper data and the app links it checks for its own name are pointed at the copy as well, not at the store app beside it. A build that keeps TikTok's package name is left alone. Google and Facebook sign-in can't work in a renamed copy, so log in with your email or phone number.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.
patches_modified.previous_description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared, and can put a host of your choosing in place of tiktok.com. A short vt.tiktok.com or vm.tiktok.com link you copy can be swapped for the full video link, off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Hushfeed settings screen to TikTok and keeps its entry first in Settings and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, and add apps you do use. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides chosen people, share options or the whole Send to row of the share sheet, and a profile's or a LIVE's share sheet can hide a different set from a video's. Apps you pick can be added to the Share via row. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the LIVE drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Show the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name on the feed. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show engagement rate
patches_modified.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows a video's engagement rate, its likes, comments, shares and saves as a share of its views, next to the creator's name and after the view count on profile grids. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Says under a profile's @username whether it follows you, or that it doesn't follow you back when you follow it. Follower and following lists mark the accounts you follow that don't follow you back. It reads the follow status TikTok already sends. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden, including when one of TikTok's experiments takes it off every video but paid content. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources banner on unverified videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first. A second switch takes away the Check sources banner on videos TikTok marks as unverified, and the warnings it shows when you share one. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens a fresh install on the feed without the interest picker, the language and gender questions, the creators to follow, the swipe up tutorial or TikTok's own notification page in front of it. Consent, age and sign-in screens still show, and so does Android's notification prompt. Its switch starts on once you pick the patch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Stops the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. It has no switch, so only patching again without it brings the ad back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok's splash-ad preload tasks and returns false from its reviewed splash and TopView gates. Other startup behavior is left in place.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. It has no switch, so only patching again undoes it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Skips TikTok's background and boot-finished device-ID update-check tasks. This may suppress some in-app update checks. Play Store updates are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps TikTok's full-screen viewer on a video when it ends instead of moving to the next one, and leaves out its next-video countdown. Swiping still moves on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. It has no switch, so only patching again without it undoes it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps TikTok's Pitaya on-device AI plugin from starting, so its native engine doesn't load and it doesn't get a copy of every analytics event TikTok logs. TikTok carries on as if the Pitaya plugin weren't installed. Remove content credential and card scanner assets also empties some of Pitaya's libraries.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the view report TikTok sends for each video you watch, which is how videos get into your Watch history. Your views stop adding to view counts and For You has less to learn from, while likes, follows, searches and TikTok's usage logs still reach it. Off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok adding your new searches to the search history it saves on the phone. Searches you already made stay until you delete them, and this doesn't change what TikTok keeps on its servers. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops videos in search results playing on their own, so each one shows its cover until you open it. The feed and the videos you open play as usual. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds two switches for stories: replay a story when it ends instead of moving on, and keep a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.
patches_modified.previous_description: Saves subtitle files beside downloaded videos and adds caption size, background, and clear-display options. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets a left swipe on a feed video do nothing or open its comments instead of opening the creator's profile. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where a second row lists languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets TikTok trust certificate authorities you install in Android's settings as well as the system's, so a proxy like mitmproxy can show you what the app sends. While it's in, anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too, so keep it to a phone you test with. Parts of TikTok that check certificates on their own may still refuse the proxy.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the short vibrations TikTok plays on its own taps and gestures, the long press buzz included. Your keyboard and your phone's own haptics stay. Its switch starts on once you pick the patch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without their slide. Swipes inside a screen still follow your finger. Its switch starts on once you pick the patch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Draws TikTok's text in your device's font instead of TikTok Sans. The icons, the gift animations and the @ and # glyphs keep their own fonts. A second switch draws every emoji with your device's emoji font instead of filling in the newest ones with Google's. Both are off by default. Restart after changing. Switches: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Download board
patches_added.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_added.name: Hide survey prompts
patches_added.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Long-press download
patches_added.description: Adds a Download button to the round menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, so you can save a pin without opening it. Slide onto the button and let go. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads, AppsFlyer tracking, Bugsnag crash reports and the recommendations Pinterest publishes to Google Engage. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. In the manifest it also turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance collection and Google Analytics' ad ID collection, and sets Google's default analytics and ad consent to denied. That part stays until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.

patches_modified.name: Disable update nag
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > More settings > Updates.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Pinterest's in-app Play Store update prompts. You can still update Pinterest yourself.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Downloads a pin or selected visible grid pins using original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. The pin menu can also copy that media's link. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds separate switches for collage, visual-search and Promote pin menu entries. Download, share and copy-link actions remain available.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches_modified.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. AI images without the label still show. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from the home feed, search, related pins and boards. AI images without Pinterest's label still show.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides Pinterest's ad-only panels. Google's ad SDK isn't started when Pinterest opens. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your ad ID in Android. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Pinterest and the ad and tracking code inside it read an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same answer Android gives after you delete your ad ID. A switch and Pause hand back the real ID.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Collapses comments panels and comment previews beneath pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins.

patches_modified.name: Hide header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides trailing header icon buttons. Back buttons, text actions and account controls remain available.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds separate switches for the Create, Updates and Search navigation buttons. Home and Profile remain available.

patches_modified.name: Hide save toasts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as "Saved to" your board or the suggestion to follow the pin's creator. The pin is still saved.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides recent-search rows and carousels on this device. It doesn't delete your account's search history.

patches_modified.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches_modified.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured board placements. Off by default. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings when you want a feed without shopping.

patches_modified.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the "Ideas you might love" row of topic bubbles under pins without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Its switch starts off, so turn it on in HushPinterest settings.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Pinterest icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds HushPinterest settings to Pinterest. Long-press Pinterest's launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Pinterest's App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: No screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Pinterest's screenshot observer from opening sharing suggestions. Screenshots still work normally.

patches_modified.name: Open links in your browser
patches_modified.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > More settings > Links.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens pin Visit links and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in keep their usual behavior. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Original-quality images
patches_modified.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Asks Pinterest for the original image with each pin and shows it in the pin closeup, and has collages pick the original before the large size. Uses more data.

patches_modified.name: Quiet email reminders
patches_modified.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Dismisses the optional confirm-your-email reminder. Account verification and sign-in checks still apply.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest. It can't be turned back on in settings, only by patching again without it. While it's in, Hide advertising ID's switch can't hand back the real ID, because Google Play services answers with zeros.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches_modified.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Pinterest's original signing certificate to its manifest, so Google sign-in can work in the patched app. It only helps with microG-RE in place of Google Play services, or with the XSpoofSignatures LSPosed module and its permission granted. Stock Google Play services ignores it, and email and password sign-in doesn't need it.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place, and short pin.it links stay as they are. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes known tracking parameters from URLs shared or copied from Pinterest. Keeps the destination, other parameters and opaque pin.it links. Turn it off or pause HushPinterest to share the original URLs.

patches_modified.name: System share sheet
patches_modified.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Uses Android's share sheet when sharing a pin link. Screenshot and download actions keep their usual behavior. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_added.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Finale dates in library and collections
patches_added.description: Adds separate disabled-by-default settings to show the latest scheduled episode date in library and collection posters.

patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Keep airing series in Upcoming
patches_added.description: Adds a disabled-by-default setting that keeps currently-airing library series in Upcoming until the scheduled finale.

patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams in Continue Watching
patches_added.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to search sources in the background for visible Continue Watching episodes and movies, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams on detail page
patches_added.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to search sources for the detail page's Play or Resume episode or movie, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Upcoming movie dates in library and collections
patches_added.description: Adds separate disabled-by-default settings to show known release dates on unreleased movie posters in library and collections.

patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams for next episode
patches_added.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to fetch the next episode's source list after 30 seconds of playback, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches_modified.name: NuvioTV - Merge tracking progress
patches_modified.description: Merges Nuvio Sync and connected tracking-provider progress, preserving the previous snapshot while providers refresh.

patches_modified.name: NuvioTV - Remaining episodes in Continue Watching
patches_modified.description: Adds a disabled-by-default setting that displays aired, unwatched episode counts for every tracking integration. Controlled by Layout > Santodan-Patches on beta4 and beta5.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a disabled-by-default Continue Watching setting that displays aired, unwatched episode counts for every tracking integration.

patches_modified.name: NuvioTV - Side-by-side installation
patches_modified.description: Installs a separately named NuvioTV clone using a configurable package name and app name.

patches_added.name: Pillo - Import weight history from JSON
patches_added.description: Adds a native Import weights JSON button above Skip in Weight > Add record. Imports SWT backup weights with their dates into the selected profile, with kg/lb selection and duplicate skipping.

patches_added.name: Pillo - Local backup and restore
patches_added.description: Adds local-file export and restore of Pillo's database, settings and app-managed files, without Google sign-in. Restore replaces current data, keeps a recovery backup and restarts Pillo.

patches_added.name: Pillo - Weight change summaries
patches_added.description: Adds signed Total weight change, an All default filter, a selectable Last since date, and Last 30 days / Last 15 days / Change summaries using full profile history.

patches_modified.name: Pillo - Hybrid Lock-Screen Notifications
patches_modified.description: Use fullscreen alarms while the phone is locked and banner notifications while it is unlocked. Select Pillo's Banner/Light notification mode.

apps.app_name: SBS On Demand for Android TV

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches_modified.name: Block listings
patches_modified.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.

patches_modified.name: Hide professional sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

patches_modified.name: UI tweaks
patches_modified.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, optionally hide profile sections (recommendations, tools, services, jobs), and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.

patches_modified.name: Bypass anti-tamper
patches_modified.description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.

patches_modified.name: Remove TBank ads
patches_modified.description: Removes TBank stories and promotional surfaces.

patches_modified.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.

patches_added.name: Unlock 3D Maps & Off-Route Alerts - AllTrails
patches_added.description: Unlocks 3D trail maps, real-time off-route audio and wrong-turn notifications, and environmental weather overlays in AllTrails.

patches_removed.name: Persistent Off-Route Audio Alerts & 3D Maps - AllTrails (Experimental)
patches_removed.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks 3D topographic trail elevation rendering, satellite weather overlays, and forces persistent wrong-turn audio alerts when straying off the trail.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Full Game - Silt (Experimental)
patches_modified.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks the full game, all oceanic abyss chapters, and in-app purchase verification in Silt by neutralizing Google Play App Signing PairIP protection, Play Integrity remediation dialogs, and Google Play Billing. (Note: Silt requires the full XAPK/OBB bundle with UnityDataAssetPack to run).
patches_modified.previous_description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks the full game, all oceanic abyss chapters, and in-app purchase verification in Silt by hooking Google Play Billing and full game license verification checks.

patches_added.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > More settings > Notifications.

Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_added.name: Change sticker size
patches_added.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_added.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_added.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_added.name: Faster downloads
patches_added.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_added.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.
patches_modified.previous_description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.description: Spoofs the App ID to bypass integrity checks. (to bypass biometric auth etc.)

patches_modified.name: Spoof apk checksums
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the apk checksums to pass integrity checks.

patches_modified.name: Spoof attestation package name
patches_modified.description: Reports the original package name in the attestation report, which otherwise reveals a renamed install. Only the report is affected, so the app keeps using its real package name everywhere else.

patches_modified.name: Spoof installer package name
patches_modified.description: Reports Google Play as the install source in the integrity report, which otherwise reveals a sideloaded install.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the app signature to pass integrity checks.

patches_modified.name: Strip image metadata
patches_modified.description: Removes EXIF metadata, including the GPS capture location, from images sent in original quality, while keeping the picture and its orientation intact.

patches_modified.name: Version info patch
patches_modified.description: Patches the version info to include '(ReVanced)' in the version string.

patches_modified.name: Auto claim TongPow
patches_modified.description: Automatically claims CHZZK TongPow rewards when they become available while watching streams.

patches_modified.name: Disable P2P
patches_modified.description: Disables CHZZK peer-assisted grid streaming and forces CDN playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables CHZZK advertisements, including live stream pre-roll, mid-roll and post-roll ads and clip feed ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide home banners
patches_modified.description: Hides promotional banners on the CHZZK home recommend tab, including the top banner carousel and the in-feed event and image banners.

patches_modified.name: Unlock cheat key
patches_modified.description: Unlocks CHZZK cheat key subscription benefits without an active subscription.

patches_modified.name: Disable P2P
patches_modified.description: Disables SOOP peer-assisted grid streaming.

patches_modified.name: Remove Catch ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads inserted between clips in the Catch feed by reporting no ad slots.

patches_modified.name: Remove VOD ads
patches_modified.description: Removes VOD pre-roll ads by reporting every stream as QuickView Plus to the player's own ad-skip check.

patches_modified.name: Remove banner ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the VOD companion and search banner ads.

patches_modified.name: Remove exit dialog ad
patches_modified.description: Removes the ad area shown in the app-exit confirmation dialog, keeping the dialog itself.

patches_modified.name: Remove intro ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the image, video and cinema intro ad banners shown on launch.

patches_modified.name: Remove list banner ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the native banner ads under the live player and in feeds by stopping their ad request, so no banner is fetched or shown.

patches_modified.name: Remove live ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the live pre-roll ad by routing every ad decision into the app's own no-video path so the stream starts immediately.

patches_modified.name: Remove live banner ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the banner ads shown under the live player by stopping their driver from attaching the banner fragments.

patches_modified.name: Remove main board ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the native "main board" banner ad shown in feeds and under the live player.

patches_removed.name: Movie Paradise - Force RevenueCat entitlement (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Forces RevenueCat entitlements active. Experimental: premium is server-authoritative, so this likely unlocks nothing.

patches_added.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches_added.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > More settings > Appearance.

patches_removed.name: Brave NTP four-column tiles
patches_removed.description: Experimental version-unpinned patch (issue #24): keeps the new-tab pinned and most-visited tiles in a four-column grid that extends downwards, the same layout Brave uses with no background image, and keeps that layout when a background image is enabled. Neutralizes the "brave.new_tab_page.show_background_image" gate in the NTP builder that otherwise forces the tiles into a single horizontally scrolling row. Default off.

patches_modified.name: Brave AMOLED theme
patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.
patches_modified.previous_description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Raised surfaces — buttons, cards, sheets and the Material You container ladder — can take their own surface color instead of one flat black, so the UI keeps an elevation step like Material 3. Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+; leaving that force off keeps the Material You roles and low-lStar selectors untouched. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.

patches_added.name: Disable auto feed refresh
patches_added.description: Adds an option to stop feeds from refreshing automatically after they become outdated.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches_added.name: Playback buffer
patches_added.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches_added.name: Restore original titles
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches_added.name: Skip silence
patches_added.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: All-In-One
patches_modified.description: Enables video playback and downloads, removes ads and upsell prompts, bypasses the region block, unlocks the hidden Laboratory menu, and adds a Telegram channel popup and a floating support button. Requires Android 10 or later.

patches_added.name: NuvioTV - Preload streams for next episode
patches_added.description: Adds an opt-in Streams setting to fetch the next episode's source list after 30 seconds of playback, reusing Nuvio's native search cache.

patches_added.name: Download images in highest available quality
patches_added.description: Uses the largest image variant provided by Pinterest for the native Download image menu action.

patches_added.name: Filter pin menu actions
patches_added.description: Hides selected native pin menu actions by their localized labels, one per line.

patches_added.name: Show pin image information
patches_added.description: Adds optional image dimensions and format information to the pin menu.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches_modified.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches_modified.description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, both switchable from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_modified.description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches_modified.description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications keep working.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.

patches_modified.name: Download pin from long press
patches_modified.description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Search nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the search navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad views
patches_modified.description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views, so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Hides the pin comments section, the comment preview and the comments button, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Recent searches" section on the search screen and below the search bar. Pinterest still logs searches server-side.

patches_modified.name: Morphe runtime names
patches_modified.description: Resolves the class Pinterest builds its toasts with, so Morphe's messages look like the app's own.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings entry
patches_modified.description: Adds the "Morphe" item to the Account Settings list to open the toggle screen.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings screen (label)
patches_modified.description: Renames the reused string resource for the "Morphe" entry in Settings, across all languages.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)
patches_modified.description: Registers the Morphe settings Activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.

patches_modified.name: Neutralize advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Returns an empty Google Advertising ID and forces "limit ad tracking", without crashing the app.

patches_modified.name: Open links in the default browser
patches_modified.description: Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Pinterest's in-app browser, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize copied links
patches_modified.description: Turns the pin.it link that "Copy link" copies, whose slug identifies who shared it, into the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize shared links
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters from the link on the Android share sheet and resolves pin.it short links to the plain pin link. Switchable from Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Set pin as wallpaper
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Set as wallpaper" option to the pin menu, which downloads the image and sets it as the device wallpaper.

patches_modified.name: Use the system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Opens the Android system share sheet instead of Pinterest's in-app share sheet, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_added.description: Affiche une pastille verte sur les dates ayant au moins un créneau avec une place disponible. Compatible avec Keep Cool 1.8.21.

patches_added.name: Keep Cool : autoriser le + dans les adresses e-mail
patches_added.description: Autorise le caractère + avant le @ dans les adresses e-mail utilisées pour se connecter. Compatible avec Keep Cool 1.8.21.

patches_removed.description: Show a green dot on calendar dates having at least one booking slot with a free place. Keepcool 1.8.21 only.

patches_added.description: Filters videos disclosing branded/paid-promotional content (Contenido Promocional tag) from For You, Following and Friends feeds.

patches_modified.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, Chromium UMA metrics, and Variations seed fetching.
