patches_added.description: Two switches for Chats inside Facebook, both off until you turn them on. One empties the list behind the row above your chats, so friends' notes and who's active go, and your own note tile may go too. The other takes out the promotional banners at the top of Chats, like the one asking you to turn on notifications. Your chats, search and new messages stay.

patches_added.name: Comment sheet options
patches_added.description: Adds three switches under Comments, all off to start. Like only stops a long press on Like from opening the reactions, another takes the GIF and sticker buttons out of the comment box, and Open every reply thread shows each comment's replies without a tap on View replies. A row there opens Facebook's own settings, where Reaction preferences can hide reaction counts.

patches_added.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches_added.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates by giving Facebook the highest version number Android allows, while Facebook's own code still reads its real one. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Once a Facebook with it is installed, a build without it won't install over it.

patches_added.name: Download any photo
patches_added.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the biggest size where your downloads go. Its switch is under Downloads.

patches_added.name: Following feed on Home
patches_added.description: Has Home load the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow, like the Feeds tab's All, instead of the ranked feed. The Feeds tab's filters stay as they are. Its switch starts off, under Opening Facebook.

patches_added.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches_added.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts. The comments stay. Its switch starts off, under Comments.

patches_added.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches_added.description: Hides the pushes for Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine outside the Menu, such as the Edits button in the Reels composer and the offer sheet after you post. Each has its own switch.

patches_added.name: Hide read receipts
patches_added.description: People you chat with in a chat that opens inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages. The chat can stay unread on this phone, and replying may still show you've read it. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches_added.name: Hide seen posts
patches_added.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days. The list stays on your phone. Turn it on under News feed.

patches_added.name: Hide tab badges
patches_added.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon. Notifications still come in, and the Notifications tab still lists them. Every switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_added.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes. What you write sends as usual. Its switches start on, under Privacy.

patches_added.name: Keep the progress bar
patches_added.description: Keeps the progress bar of reels at full size, so you can drag it without tapping first, and keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap. Its switch starts off, under Playback.

patches_added.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches_added.description: Photos and videos you send from a chat that opens inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of Facebook's smaller copies. The switch starts off, under Chats.

patches_added.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches_added.description: Shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation. Facebook's See translation link stays under each one. The switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Always upload in HD
patches_added.description: Makes TikTok treat its own HD upload choice as on for every video you post, as if you'd turned it on yourself on the post page. A clip TikTok doesn't count as high quality posts as before. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: App lock
patches_added.description: Puts TikTok behind your phone's own unlock, so a fingerprint or the screen lock PIN opens it. It asks when TikTok starts and when you come back after a time you pick, before anything shows. A link you open from another app still goes to its video once you unlock, and TikTok's preview in recent apps stays blank while the lock is on. On a phone with no screen lock, TikTok opens as before and says why. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Block popups
patches_added.description: Lets you stop TikTok's own popups one at a time, like the follow-your-friends card or an upsell. The checklist lists each popup TikTok has tried to show on your phone, the sheets its server sends as campaigns included, so one appears there after its first showing. Tick it and it stays away from then on. A switch beside it hides the LIVE bubble at the top of the feed, which never reaches the checklist. Another keeps TikTok's bedtime wind-down and daily limit screens off the feed, on an account TikTok knows is an adult's. Nothing is blocked until you tick something or turn it on. CAPTCHA, verification, sign-in, age, ban and legal consent screens are never listed and never blocked. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_added.description: Long-press a profile's bio to copy it. A profile's share sheet, the one its menu opens, gets buttons that copy its username and numeric user ID, and a video's share sheet gets one that copies the video ID. Account facts, off by default, adds a profile button that shows when the account joined, its region and when its names last changed, from what TikTok already sent. Switches: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok's launcher icon a themed version, so on Android 13 and up it takes your wallpaper's color when themed icons are on. Its options can also swap in a black background or a plain one-color note on Android 8 and up, or put a PNG of your own in the note's place.

patches_added.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that plays the audio on videos TikTok silenced because their sound was pulled for copyright or in your region. TikTok may still label the sound as unavailable. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: LIVE controls
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that stops a LIVE in the feed counting down and taking you into the room on its own, so you stay in the feed until you tap it, and one that shows a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of TikTok's rounded one. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Lift text length limits
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that lets comments, repost notes and your bio run past the length TikTok's app stops at. TikTok's servers can still turn down a long one. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Network proxy
patches_added.description: Sends TikTok's own network stack, which carries the feed, search, comments and the rest of its API, through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy you set, along with plain Java connections. Videos and LIVE streams load through TikTok's player, which connects on its own, so they stay direct. TikTok's network stack can't sign in to a proxy, so a user name and password only reach the Java connections. Other apps aren't affected. Off by default. Restart after changing. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that keeps the video you're watching playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, with a button to pause it. Works in the feed and on videos opened from a profile, search or a sound. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_added.description: Plays the standard version of videos that also come in HDR, so the screen doesn't jump to full brightness when one starts. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_added.description: Plays the H.264 version of a video when TikTok offers one beside its HEVC and ByteVC2 versions, for phones that stutter or run hot playing those. A video with no H.264 version plays as before. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_added.description: Adds switches that take the story ring and the pulsing LIVE ring off profile pictures, so a tap opens the profile. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Run beside the store app
patches_added.description: Lets a TikTok copy renamed with Morphe's Clone app patch sign in while the store app stays installed. Select it together with Clone app. When the copy registers your phone with TikTok it gives TikTok's own package name, because TikTok's servers don't hand out a device ID for a name they don't know and signing in fails without one. Its settings shared between TikTok's processes, its live wallpaper data and the app links it checks for its own name are pointed at the copy as well, not at the store app beside it. A build that keeps TikTok's package name is left alone. Google and Facebook sign-in can't work in a renamed copy, so log in with your email or phone number.

patches_added.name: Show engagement rate
patches_added.description: Shows a video's engagement rate, its likes, comments, shares and saves as a share of its views, next to the creator's name and after the view count on profile grids. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Show follow status
patches_added.description: Says under a profile's @username whether it follows you, or that it doesn't follow you back when you follow it. Follower and following lists mark the accounts you follow that don't follow you back. It reads the follow status TikTok already sends. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_added.description: Opens a fresh install on the feed without the interest picker, the language and gender questions, the creators to follow, the swipe up tutorial or TikTok's own notification page in front of it. Consent, age and sign-in screens still show, and so does Android's notification prompt. Its switch starts on once you pick the patch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_added.description: Stops the view report TikTok sends for each video you watch, which is how videos get into your Watch history. Your views stop adding to view counts and For You has less to learn from, while likes, follows, searches and TikTok's usage logs still reach it. Off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_added.description: Stops videos in search results playing on their own, so each one shows its cover until you open it. The feed and the videos you open play as usual. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Story controls
patches_added.description: Adds two switches for stories: replay a story when it ends instead of moving on, and keep a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Trust user certificates
patches_added.description: Lets TikTok trust certificate authorities you install in Android's settings as well as the system's, so a proxy like mitmproxy can show you what the app sends. While it's in, anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too, so keep it to a phone you test with. Parts of TikTok that check certificates on their own may still refuse the proxy.

patches_added.name: Turn off haptics
patches_added.description: Stops the short vibrations TikTok plays on its own taps and gestures, the long press buzz included. Your keyboard and your phone's own haptics stay. Its switch starts on once you pick the patch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_added.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without their slide. Swipes inside a screen still follow your finger. Its switch starts on once you pick the patch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds download quality choices, original Photo Mode images, separate audio files and optional video details. A photo post can also save as one video with its sound and no TikTok logo. It can check for an existing saved video before downloading another copy, and mark the videos it saved on profile grids. Long presses save profile pictures and stories. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Automatic video advance

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments that contain chosen words or come from chosen accounts, turns the thumbs down on each comment into a block button that shows the block symbol, makes links tappable, can show a poll's results before you vote and can hide pictures, polls, surveys or TikTok's suggested-search banner above comments. patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds diagnostic logging, a 15-minute log that stops by itself, filtered reports and local TikTok crash capture. The switches are under Diagnostics in Hushfeed settings. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds diagnostic logging, filtered reports and local TikTok crash capture. The switches are under Diagnostics in Hushfeed settings. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Has TikTok keep only the frame on screen for each animated sticker or GIF instead of caching every frame, and stops it decoding frames ahead of time. Each next frame is built from the one before it, so animations still play smoothly while using less memory.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes TikTok's reviewed Fresco animated-frame cache lookups return no cached frame. This can increase decoding work or change animation playback.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, including videos with creator commission disclosures and creator posts TikTok runs as ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI-generated videos, location-tagged videos, verified accounts, series, mini dramas, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge, inserted cards and the offline videos TikTok slips back into For You. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from, the language of their original caption and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. Caption words can also match the text stickers typed over a video. For You can also drop the fill-in videos TikTok sends without picking them for you, and a batch that's all fill-in stays so the feed never runs dry. The Friends tab can show only mutual friends. A short list of creator exceptions lets chosen accounts through the filters on the kind of post, its labels, age, length and counts, and through the fill-in rule. Ads, blocked creators, words, sounds, countries and caption languages, paid and Shop content, LIVE, seen videos and offline videos still apply to them. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded and the ads a creator's video pager asks for on its own. The share prompt that appears after a like can be hidden too, and so can TikTok Shop's Products block and product cards in search results. The LIVE feed you swipe through has its own rules: gaming, shopping, sponsored and verified LIVEs, categories, and viewer and follower ranges. A small label on the Home feed can count what the filter has taken out. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. TikTok's push service doesn't start and nothing it posts reaches the drawer, apart from ongoing ones like media controls. It can't hold your phone awake either. You won't hear about new messages until you open TikTok, and turning the switch off sets push up again the next time TikTok starts. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.previous_description: Matches locale, timezone and native region getters to the SIM preset, with a separate experimental store-region switch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's co-host (link-mic) and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. In LIVE the red and blue battle score bar and the co-host guests' names can go missing, and co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working. The APK gets about 3 MB smaller.

patches_added.name: Block popups

Tick it and it stays away from then on. A switch beside it hides the LIVE bubble at the top of the feed, which never reaches the checklist. patches_added.name: Lift text length limits

patches_added.name: Network proxy
patches_added.description: Sends TikTok's own network stack, which carries the feed, search, comments and the rest of its API, through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy you set, along with plain Java connections. Videos and LIVE streams load through TikTok's player, which connects on its own, so they stay direct. TikTok's network stack can't sign in to a proxy, so a user name and password only reach the Java connections. Other apps aren't affected. Off by default. Restart after changing. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture

patches_added.name: Play SDR instead of HDR

patches_added.name: Show follow status
patches_added.description: Says under a profile's @username whether it follows you, or that it doesn't follow you back when you follow it. Follower and following lists mark the accounts you follow that don't follow you back. It reads the follow status TikTok already sends. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, including videos with creator commission disclosures and creator posts TikTok runs as ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labeled videos, location-tagged videos, verified accounts, series, mini dramas, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from, the language of their original caption and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. For You can also drop the fill-in videos TikTok sends without picking them for you, and a batch that's all fill-in stays so the feed never runs dry. A short list of creator exceptions lets chosen accounts through the filters on the kind of post, its labels, age, length and counts, and through the fill-in rule. Ads, blocked creators, words, sounds, countries and caption languages, paid and Shop content, LIVE and seen videos still apply to them. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded and the ads a creator's video pager asks for on its own. The share prompt that appears after a like can be hidden too, and so can TikTok Shop's Products block and product cards in search results. The LIVE feed you swipe through has its own rules: gaming, shopping, sponsored and verified LIVEs, categories, and viewer and follower ranges. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Has TikTok keep only the frame on screen for each animated sticker or GIF instead of caching every frame, and stops it decoding frames ahead of time. Each next frame is built from the one before it, so animations still play smoothly while using less memory.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes TikTok's reviewed Fresco animated-frame cache lookups return no cached frame. This can increase decoding work or change animation playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's co-host (link-mic) and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. In LIVE the red and blue battle score bar and the co-host guests' names can go missing, and co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working. The APK gets about 3 MB smaller.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop. The APK gets about 3 MB smaller.

patches_added.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_added.description: Long-press a profile's bio to copy it. A profile's share sheet, the one its menu opens, gets buttons that copy its username and numeric user ID, and a video's share sheet gets one that copies the video ID. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Gives TikTok's launcher icon a themed version, so on Android 13 and up it takes your wallpaper's color when themed icons are on. Its options can also swap in a black background or a plain one-color note on Android 8 and up.

patches_added.name: Lift text length limits
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that lets comments, repost notes and your bio run past the length TikTok's app stops at. TikTok's servers can still turn down a long one. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_added.description: Plays the standard version of videos that also come in HDR, so the screen doesn't jump to full brightness when one starts. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_added.description: Adds switches that take the story ring and the pulsing LIVE ring off profile pictures, so a tap opens the profile. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Account sheet cleanup
patches_added.description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.

patches_added.name: Hide ads and clutter
patches_added.description: Hides promoted map pins and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the home tab's Explore feed and the Explore / Contribute / You tabs. Each can be switched back on on the Customization screen.

patches_added.name: Remove sign-in prompts
patches_added.description: Removes Google's sign-in prompts: the first-launch "Make it your map" page, the search screen's "Tired of typing?" card and the account sheet's "Sign in" pill. Tapping "Your profile" (or the pill, where it still shows) answers with a "Can't sign in" toast instead of nothing.

patches_added.name: Add microG support
patches_added.description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu, Offline saved places and Remove permissions are left out of this build, and its icon carries microG's C. Needs MicroG-RE 7.2.1 or newer; ReVanced GmsCore runs the map but does not pass your account to Maps. Not for root (mount) installs.

patches_removed.name: Hide AI
patches_removed.description: Hides Gemini's AI summaries: the "Know before you go" card on place sheets and the review summary ("Summarized with Gemini") on the Reviews tab. Can be switched off on the Customization screen.

patches_removed.name: Hide ads
patches_removed.description: Hides promoted map pins and "Sponsored" search result rows.

patches_removed.name: Hide explore feed
patches_removed.description: Hides the home tab's Explore feed sheet ("Local vibe"). Can be switched back on on the Customization screen.

patches_removed.name: Hide login promo
patches_removed.description: Hides the full-screen "Make it your map" page shown on first launch.

patches_removed.name: Hide navigation tabs
patches_removed.description: Hides the Explore / Contribute / You strip at the bottom of the home screen. Can be switched back on on the Customization screen.

patches_removed.name: Hide section title
patches_removed.description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet.

patches_removed.name: Hide sign-in button
patches_removed.description: Removes the "Sign in" pill from the account sheet.

patches_removed.name: Hide suggestions
patches_removed.description: Hides the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet: a preview of the address's Directory (the restaurants, shops and offices at that address). The Directory button still lists them. Can be switched off on the Customization screen.

patches_removed.name: Keep account sheet open
patches_removed.description: Returning from Settings or Customization, or tapping "Your profile", leaves the account sheet open instead of dropping back to the map.

patches_removed.name: Network location fallback
patches_removed.description: Keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) location provider registered when no fused location provider answers, instead of GPS-only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.

patches_removed.name: Offline timeline
patches_removed.description: Adds a Timeline to the Local saved screen: a record of where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs.

patches_removed.name: Remove sign-in promo
patches_removed.description: Removes the "Tired of typing?" sign-in card from the search screen.

patches_removed.name: Restore map data
patches_removed.description: Lets a re-signed Maps load tiles, search and routing, by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks, and by degrading instead of crashing when Play services rejects the re-signed app -- including skipping a view property that fails for that reason instead of crashing the screen.

patches_removed.name: Sign-in toast
patches_removed.description: The "Sign in" pill shows a "Can't sign in" toast instead of failing silently.

patches_removed.name: Your profile toast
patches_removed.description: Tapping "Your profile" shows a "Can't sign in" toast instead of opening nothing.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Play Services checks
patches_modified.description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent.

patches_modified.name: Location provider toggle
patches_modified.description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, Play services is never asked for a location. Play services is never used while it is missing or disabled, so location keeps working on phones without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.

With Android, Play services is never asked for a location. Play services is never used while it is missing or disabled, so location keeps working on phones without it.

patches_modified.name: Offline saved places
patches_modified.description: Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Maps' You tab -- your recent places, your lists and labels (Home, Work, your own) -- with export and import (backup file, KML, Google Takeout's Saved Places.json). It also has a Timeline: where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs.

patches_modified.name: Power saving mode
patches_modified.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Customization > Power Saving Options > Power saving mode is turned on. Power Saving Options also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.

patches_modified.name: Legacy icon
patches_modified.description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon. With Add microG support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.
patches_modified.previous_description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon.

patches_modified.name: Remove permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.

patches_modified.name: Remove telemetry
patches_modified.description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services. With Add microG support, Firebase Installations and Location History are left alone, so Timeline, account sync and push messages keep working.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots
patches_added.description: Lets screenshots and screen recordings work wherever Instagram blocks them, like disappearing photos and videos in your chats.

patches_added.name: Ask before a call
patches_added.description: Asks before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on a call button doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Ask before a like
patches_added.description: Asks before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't. Continue goes ahead and Cancel doesn't. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_added.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_added.description: Asks before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so a stray pull keeps what's on screen. Refresh goes ahead, and Cancel stops the spinner. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_added.name: Change the like animation
patches_added.description: Plays an animation you pick, from the ones Instagram made for Instagram Rings creators, in the heart that pops up when you double tap a post. Its switch, under Reels, starts off.

patches_added.name: Change version code
patches_added.description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Instagram's checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Once it's in, going back to an unpatched Instagram means uninstalling first, which deletes Instagram's data on your phone, and later HushGram builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.

patches_added.name: Clear the media cache
patches_added.description: Once Instagram's cache holds more than 500 MB of images and videos, deletes the images when it goes to the background and the videos the next time it starts. A Clear now row shows what it freed. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay.

patches_added.name: Data saver
patches_added.description: Loads photos at a smaller size and starts videos, reels and stories at the lowest quality, on mobile data or on every network. It works through Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it brings both along.

patches_added.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_added.description: Keeps Instagram from noticing your screenshots, so whoever sent you a disappearing photo or video isn't told you took one.

patches_added.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_added.description: Keeps what you open from search out of Recent, both in the app and on Instagram's side. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them.

patches_added.name: Download voice messages
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save to the menu you get by holding a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Full resolution photos
patches_added.description: Loads photos in your feed, in carousels and in posts you open at the largest size Instagram sends rather than the size it picks for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on a phone under 1440 pixels wide. It can use more data.

patches_added.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_added.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group per type with a second switch, so they don't fill the notification shade. A group of two or more shows how many it holds. Tapping a notification still opens what it did.

patches_added.name: Hide Instants
patches_added.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instagram is told your account doesn't have Instants, its no-edit camera for friends.

patches_added.name: Hide comments
patches_added.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off the posts in your feed, with a switch under Comments that starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch so the people you're chatting with don't see when you're typing. Unlike turning off the typing indicator in Instagram's settings, you still see when they're typing.

patches_added.name: Hide the Share button
patches_added.description: Takes the Share button and its count off the posts in your feed and off reels, with a switch under Sharing that starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide the home feed
patches_added.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows the stories row and nothing under it. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts.

patches_added.name: Keep in chat
patches_added.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats, as if they'd been sent with Keep in chat, so they don't disappear after you open them. Turning it on or off reaches the ones already loaded once the chat loads again.

patches_added.name: Lock your messages
patches_added.description: Adds switches that keep your inbox and chats, or all of Instagram, covered until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. They lock again when you leave Instagram or after the time you pick, and message notifications say only that a message came.

patches_added.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch so opening a chat doesn't tell people you've seen their messages. Unlike turning off read receipts in Instagram's settings, you still see when they've seen yours. Instagram's Mark as read still lets them know, whether you long press one chat or pick several. View-once photos and videos have their own patch.

patches_added.name: Save profile picture
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save profile picture row to the menu on someone's profile. It saves their picture at the largest size Instagram has. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_added.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, under it in your feed, and the date and time of each comment, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_added.name: Spoof location
patches_added.description: Tells Instagram the phone is at a place you set in HushGram's settings, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places.

patches_added.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_added.description: Keeps a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still changes tabs, and Reels still scroll up and down.

patches_added.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_added.description: Keeps HDR photos and reels from brightening the screen above everything else, with a switch under Playback that starts off.

patches_added.name: View live anonymously
patches_added.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. A live that ends can keep looking live until you leave it. Your own lives still count their viewers.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity with the comment preview, and the comment bar under a reposted reel. Each part has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality

patches_modified.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels under the Search tab's bar. Search, your recent searches and search results stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and a start or a notification meant for it opens Home. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open, and a change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Repost button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still sends a post or reel to someone.

patches_modified.name: Hide the notes row
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of notes off the top of your messages, the Map bubble in it too. Your chats, search and requests stay.

patches_modified.name: HushGram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds HushGram settings to Instagram. Long-press Instagram's launcher icon and pick HushGram settings, or tap HushGram settings at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity. You can also choose one tab whose long press opens HushGram. That choice starts off. Turn features on or off, pause HushGram and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds HushGram settings to Instagram. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Once you turn on Instagram's auto scroll in Reels, it stays on after Instagram restarts or you leave Reels, until you turn it off yourself.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Ads keep Instagram's own rules.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock (hold its edge, then slide down) and the next reels play at 2x too, until you slide the lock off, hold the edge and let go, or Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Loop a story
patches_modified.description: A story plays again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on.

patches_modified.name: Open developer options
patches_modified.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where its server flags (MetaConfig and quick experiments) can be looked at and overridden on your phone. A wrong flag can break parts of Instagram until you reset it there.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens a web link you tap in your default browser instead of Instagram's in-app browser, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram and other Meta pages, and ads, still open in the app.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Instagram's dark mode uses pure black instead of its near-black gray, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus, sheets and buttons keep their own grays so they stay easy to see. Chosen when you patch, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build doesn't update on its own, so without this it would stop working after a few weeks.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Instagram can't read your phone's advertising ID or tell Android's ad services which ads you saw or tapped. The permissions for them are taken out of the build, so Google Play services hands Instagram a string of zeros in place of the ID.

patches_modified.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Takes away the empty room Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there, on a phone that hides its navigation bar and in a pop-up window. A change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own signature checks pass on a re-signed build, so the parts of the app that check who signed it keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key open from Instagram too, and Instagram trusts them when they share to it or ask it for your sign-in. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.
patches_modified.previous_description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes stkn, igsh, utm_source and Instagram's other tracking keys off the links you copy or share, and opens a bio link without going through Instagram's click tracker. The post, reel, story or profile a link opens stays the same.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds an optional Save action to the common comment menu when a comment has a photo of its own. It saves the largest size Instagram sent, the same way Download saves a post's photo.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted in its header, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under its switch can show the time left before the story expires, or only the time it went up. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the date and time a story was posted in its header, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any, or as a chip under their counts that also says Following each other. A second switch, off to start, marks the accounts on your own Following list that don't follow you back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any. A second switch, off to start, marks the accounts on your own Following list that don't follow you back.

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following
patches_modified.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow. Tap Following at the top to switch to For you, and Home remembers your pick. A second switch, off to start, takes For you out of Home. A change to either shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram from crashing or freezing on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an x86 Chromebook or an emulator, by skipping the one code protection step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before.

patches_modified.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping until you've had a 15 minute break.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Instagram's timing.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_modified.description: Keeps a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button and every other way into the camera still work.

patches_modified.name: Story ring size
patches_modified.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on the screen, or larger. Pick the size in HushGram's settings.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. Feed videos show a play button, the way they do when Instagram saves mobile data.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A switch for comments starts off. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.

patches_modified.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches_modified.description: Adds an off-by-default switch to hold back the opened receipt for view-once photos and videos in messages. Ordinary chat and voice receipts keep Instagram's behavior.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Holds story-view reports while its switch is on. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep showing as new. An optional Mark as seen button selects stories to send.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots
patches_added.description: Lets screenshots and screen recordings work wherever Instagram blocks them, like disappearing photos and videos in your chats.

patches_added.name: Ask before a call
patches_added.description: Asks before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on a call button doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Ask before a like
patches_added.description: Asks before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't. Continue goes ahead and Cancel doesn't. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_added.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_added.description: Asks before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so a stray pull keeps what's on screen. Refresh goes ahead, and Cancel stops the spinner. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_added.name: Change the like animation
patches_added.description: Plays an animation you pick, from the ones Instagram made for Instagram Rings creators, in the heart that pops up when you double tap a post. Its switch, under Reels, starts off.

patches_added.name: Change version code
patches_added.description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Instagram's checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Once it's in, going back to an unpatched Instagram means uninstalling first, which deletes Instagram's data on your phone, and later HushGram builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.

patches_added.name: Clear the media cache
patches_added.description: Once Instagram's cache holds more than 500 MB of images and videos, deletes the images when it goes to the background and the videos the next time it starts. A Clear now row shows what it freed. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay.

patches_added.name: Data saver
patches_added.description: Loads photos at a smaller size and starts videos, reels and stories at the lowest quality, on mobile data or on every network. It works through Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it brings both along.

patches_added.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_added.description: Keeps Instagram from noticing your screenshots, so whoever sent you a disappearing photo or video isn't told you took one.

patches_added.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_added.description: Keeps what you open from search out of Recent, both in the app and on Instagram's side. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them.

patches_added.name: Download voice messages
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save to the menu you get by holding a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Full resolution photos
patches_added.description: Loads photos in your feed, in carousels and in posts you open at the largest size Instagram sends rather than the size it picks for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on a phone under 1440 pixels wide. It can use more data.

patches_added.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_added.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group per type with a second switch, so they don't fill the notification shade. A group of two or more shows how many it holds. Tapping a notification still opens what it did.

patches_added.name: Hide Instants
patches_added.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instagram is told your account doesn't have Instants, its no-edit camera for friends.

patches_added.name: Hide comments
patches_added.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off the posts in your feed, with a switch under Comments that starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch so the people you're chatting with don't see when you're typing. Unlike turning off the typing indicator in Instagram's settings, you still see when they're typing.

patches_added.name: Hide the Share button
patches_added.description: Takes the Share button and its count off the posts in your feed and off reels, with a switch under Sharing that starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide the home feed
patches_added.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows the stories row and nothing under it. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts.

patches_added.name: Keep in chat
patches_added.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats, as if they'd been sent with Keep in chat, so they don't disappear after you open them. Turning it on or off reaches the ones already loaded once the chat loads again.

patches_added.name: Lock your messages
patches_added.description: Adds switches that keep your inbox and chats, or all of Instagram, covered until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. They lock again when you leave Instagram or after the time you pick, and message notifications say only that a message came.

patches_added.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch so opening a chat doesn't tell people you've seen their messages. Unlike turning off read receipts in Instagram's settings, you still see when they've seen yours. Instagram's Mark as read still lets them know, whether you long press one chat or pick several. View-once photos and videos have their own patch.

patches_added.name: Save profile picture
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save profile picture row to the menu on someone's profile. It saves their picture at the largest size Instagram has. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_added.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, under it in your feed, and the date and time of each comment, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_added.name: Spoof location
patches_added.description: Tells Instagram the phone is at a place you set in HushGram's settings, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places.

patches_added.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_added.description: Keeps a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still changes tabs, and Reels still scroll up and down.

patches_added.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_added.description: Keeps HDR photos and reels from brightening the screen above everything else, with a switch under Playback that starts off.

patches_added.name: View live anonymously
patches_added.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. A live that ends can keep looking live until you leave it. Your own lives still count their viewers.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity with the comment preview, and the comment bar under a reposted reel. Each part has its own switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and friends' activity with the comment preview. Each part has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds an optional Copy action to the common comment menu. Copies the original text with its line breaks.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Sends Instagram's usage events and crash reports to an address on your phone that refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's servers. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens, which would come back on every start without those events. Restart Instagram after changing the switch.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops telling Instagram which reels you watched and how far into them you got. It's used to rank your Reels, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark. Turn on Download cover for a row that saves the still picture shown before the reel plays.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. A video saves at the Download quality you set, a photo at its largest size. A photo story with music offers Download as video and Download as photo.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. A video saves at the Download quality you set, a photo at its largest size.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video, and of a carousel showing a video. Videos save at the Download quality you set, without Instagram's watermark. A second switch does the same for photo posts. Another adds Details, with the post's time, who posted it, its media ID and buttons that copy its direct link, the username and the caption.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video, and of a carousel showing a video. Videos save at the Download quality you set, without Instagram's watermark. A second switch does the same for photo posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Takes Meta AI out of the search bars, in the Search tab and at the top of your messages, so they search the plain way, drops the Ask a follow-up bar under search results and Meta AI's buttons in Home's top bar and the message composer, hides its optional row in your inbox, and removes Meta AI's posts from your home feed. It can also take About this reel, or only its Ask Meta AI box, out of a reel's More menu. Search, posts, About this reel and Ask Meta AI have separate switches, and the last two start off. The search switch applies after Instagram restarts.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes Meta AI out of the search bars, in the Search tab and at the top of your messages, so they search the plain way, drops the Ask a follow-up bar under search results and Meta AI's buttons in Home's top bar and the message composer, hides its optional row in your inbox, and removes Meta AI's posts from your home feed. Search and posts have separate switches. The search switch applies after Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels between posts in your home feed, and the other units that open the Reels viewer from there. A reel someone you follow posts stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories. Instagram is told the ad didn't go in, so no gap is left where it would have been.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button away from beside the share sheet's search bar, and the button that sends to the people you picked as one group, so they get it one by one. You can still start a group from your messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and the Add to highlight list on your stories stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of people and creators to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and follower lists stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the posts and reels from accounts you don't follow that Instagram puts in your home feed as Suggested for you, the rows of accounts, shops and hashtags it suggests you follow, the posts and accounts from Threads it mixes in, the surveys it asks you to fill in, and its shopping rows. Each has its own switch. Posts from accounts you follow stay.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the posts and reels from accounts you don't follow that Instagram puts in your home feed as Suggested for you, the rows of accounts, shops and hashtags it suggests you follow, and the posts and accounts from Threads it mixes in. Each has its own switch. Posts from accounts you follow stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the stories from accounts you don't follow, and the accounts Instagram suggests, from the row of stories at the top of Home. More switches, off to start, take out rewinds, memories and recaps, stop the row's stories loading, or take the whole row away.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the stories from accounts you don't follow, and the accounts Instagram suggests, from the row of stories at the top of Home. A second switch, off to start, takes the whole row away.

patches_modified.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Play all
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Playback buffer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches_modified.name: Playback in feeds
patches_modified.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Player icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Reload video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Restore original titles
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_modified.name: Skip silence
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation
patches_modified.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_added.name: MicroG manifest support
patches_added.description: Adds MicroG package visibility queries, permissions, and spoofing metadata to AndroidManifest.xml.

patches_added.name: MicroG support
patches_added.description: Redirects Google account sign-in and authentication to MicroG (app.revanced.android.gms) on non-rooted devices.

patches_added.description: Blocks promotional and marketing prompts and modals. Note: this only affects in-app promo sheets. Match-alert push delivery on re-signed builds needs working push delivery - use MicroG integration + signature spoofing where Play Services is absent (issue #25).

patches_added.description: Threads' dark mode uses pure black instead of its dark gray behind your feed, posts and profiles, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus and sheets keep their own grays.

patches_modified.name: Brave AMOLED theme
patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Raised surfaces — buttons, cards, sheets and the Material You container ladder — can take their own surface color instead of one flat black, so the UI keeps an elevation step like Material 3. Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+; leaving that force off keeps the Material You roles and low-lStar selectors untouched. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.

patches_added.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_added.description: Pinterest and the ad and tracking code inside it read an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same answer Android gives after you delete your ad ID. A switch and Pause hand back the real ID.

patches_added.name: Hide save toasts
patches_added.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as "Saved to" your board or the suggestion to follow the pin's creator. The pin is still saved.

patches_added.name: Original-quality images
patches_added.description: Has Pinterest's image model pick the original image before its large size wherever Pinterest supplied one. Uses more data.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads, AppsFlyer tracking, Bugsnag crash reports and the recommendations Pinterest publishes to Google Engage. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. Firebase Analytics is disabled in the manifest and stays disabled until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads and AppsFlyer tracking. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. Firebase Analytics is disabled in the manifest and stays disabled until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Downloads a pin or selected visible grid pins using original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. The pin menu can also copy that media's link. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download pin to the pin menu for original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides Pinterest's ad-only panels. Google's ad SDK isn't started when Pinterest opens. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides Pinterest's ad-only panels. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_added.name: Disable Cloud Backup
patches_added.description: Disables Android backup for Gboard (allowBackup=false and backup agent removed) so keyboard settings, learned words, and personal dictionary data are never uploaded to Google Drive backups or copied by device-to-device transfer.

patches_added.name: Disable Play Services Integration
patches_added.description: Makes Gboard's Google Play services availability check always report SERVICE_DISABLED, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, account sync, Google Help feedback) are skipped at the source instead of being attempted.

patches_modified.name: Hardened Intent Security
patches_modified.description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking and removes the exported, permissionless web debug bridge content provider.
patches_modified.previous_description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking.

patches_added.name: Direct Message Declutter
patches_added.description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, and sticker reply suggestions.

patches_added.name: Disable HDR Video Playback
patches_added.description: Forces the video playback engine to select standard SDR bitrates (BT.709/sRGB) instead of HDR (HDR10/PQ/HLG), preventing blinding screen brightness spikes and display thermal throttling while preserving smooth playback.

patches_added.name: Fix Spotify Login
patches_added.description: Restores the 'Add to Spotify' music button after patching by routing the Spotify app sign-in, which rejects the modified APK signature, through Spotify's Web-based OAuth.

patches_added.name: Friends Feed Strict Mutuals
patches_added.description: Filters out suggested accounts, recommended videos, and non-mutual profiles (such as 'People you may know') from the Friends feed so it only plays videos from accounts you mutually follow.

patches_added.name: Popups & Prompts Suppressor
patches_added.description: Suppresses intrusive popups, dialogs, and modal prompts, including 'Follow your friends' dialogs, contacts sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, 2SV security checkup modals, PopLayer promotional sheets, live stream teaser bubbles, sticker recommendations, and DM streak expiration warnings.

patches_added.name: System Font
patches_added.description: Forces TikTok to use the Android system font instead of bundled proprietary TikTokSans fonts.

patches_modified.name: Comment Customizer
patches_modified.description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, hiding comment quick actions, hiding in-comment surveys and feedback cards, hiding profile photo story rings, enabling voice comments, and automatic comment translation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, enabling voice comments, and automatic comment translation.

patches_modified.name: Disable Feed Long-Press Actions
patches_modified.description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis.

patches_modified.name: Feed Bloat & Distraction Blocker
patches_modified.description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You, Following, and Friends feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), community/topic cards, post-video surveys and evaluation questionnaires, mini-drama paywalls, and in-feed search recommendations/interest cards.

patches_modified.name: Feed Interface Declutter
patches_modified.description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the repost pill, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.

patches_modified.name: Hide Inbox Promos & Alerts
patches_modified.description: Hides promotional banners, streak mascot cards, contact sync suggestions, friend recommendations, and migration guide tooltips in the inbox and direct messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide Inbox Story & Status Tray
patches_modified.description: Hides the horizontal story, notes, and status tray (Skylight) displayed at the top of direct messages and the inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide Seen Videos
