patches_added.name: Allow screenshots
patches_added.description: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on the pages Facebook blocks them on. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches_added.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches_added.description: Games you play in Facebook get no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none to show, so a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on.

patches_added.name: Block screenshot detection
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats, games and everywhere else. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches_added.name: Hide tabs
patches_added.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar: Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events. Each page stays in the Menu. Every switch starts off, and a change shows once Facebook restarts.

patches_added.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook uploading its app analytics in the background and skips its on-device learning jobs. Its switch starts on, under Privacy. Restart Facebook after changing it.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook, through the picture-in-picture Facebook already has for Reels. Needs Android 12 or later.

patches_added.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches_added.description: Every seller's page in Marketplace gets View profile, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. Its switch starts on, under Marketplace.

patches_added.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches_added.description: Keeps HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness. They play at the same resolution, in the screen's usual range. Its switch starts on, under Playback.

patches_added.name: Turn off haptics
patches_added.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays on its own taps and gestures. The keyboard and your phone's own haptics stay. Its switch starts on, under Appearance.

patches_added.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_added.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, its Menu and the screens that open over it at once, without the slide between them. Swiping and animations inside a page stay. Its switch starts on, under Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI, a fourth takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds between posts, and a fifth removes posts featuring Meta's AI characters. The Meta AI cards switch starts on. The others start off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI. Every switch starts off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results. The feed's request asks Facebook to leave them out and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. Ads that come back among search results are taken out before Marketplace shows them, and a video ad that reaches the feed anyway isn't drawn. The listings people post stay.

patches_modified.name: Restore original titles

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style

patches_modified.name: Skip silence
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar

patches_modified.name: Yandex voice-over translation

patches_modified.name: App refresh rate

patches_modified.name: Change start page

patches_modified.name: Disable DRC audio

patches_modified.name: Force portrait orientation

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds one-tap controls for blocking the creator, hiding them locally and blocking the current sound. A confirmed account block skips to the next video and shows a small Unblock button at the top left for two seconds. The local-hide and sound controls start off and have separate switches, and either one can show without the block control. Long press any visible control to move it. Hushfeed keeps it clear of system bars, cutouts and TikTok's bottom tabs when the window changes. A local action shows Undo only after its setting was saved. All controls hide while comments are open. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and the Add to highlight list on your stories stay.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds an optional Save action to the common comment menu when a comment has a photo of its own. It saves the largest size Instagram sent, the same way Download saves a post's photo.

patches_modified.description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays

patches_modified.name: Disable Bottom Bar And Add Me Tab To Top
patches_modified.description: Adds a permanent Me tab button to the toolbar. Hiding the bottom bar itself is toggled live in Me tab > Mod Settings, not here - the Me tab button always stays wired, on purpose, since Mod Settings lives behind it and turning it off should never be able to lock you out of turning it back on.

patches_modified.name: Disable signature verification
patches_modified.description: Patches libc++_shared.so (arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a) to branch-to-self at the signature check call site, hanging that code path instead of letting it fail the app.

patches_modified.name: Remove Recycle Bin
patches_modified.description: Deleted files are always removed permanently, whenever this patch is applied - there's no safe way to make that half a runtime switch without the stock (unpatched) delete-dialog code to fall back to. The Me tab tile itself is a Mod Settings switch: off just brings the tile back, it doesn't restore recycling.

patches_modified.name: Replace FFmpeg codec
patches_modified.description: Replaces libffmpeg.mx.so in every lib/<abi>/ folder present in the APK with the matching file from a selected codec zip (EAC3 support). neon64 -> arm64-v8a, neon -> armeabi-v7a, x86 -> x86, x86_64 -> x86_64. ABI folders missing from the APK or from the zip are skipped.

patches_modified.description: Replaces the Smart Enhance toggle with a 0-100% popup slider and keeps the level after lock/unlock.

patches_removed.name: Background blue-noise dithering (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Static blue-noise quantization after video colour processing and fade, only on the background/base layer. Accepts 8-bit or 10-bit input and always uses 8-bit sRGB output. Select independently or together with the other layer's blue-noise patch. Separate from OLED/VD-like processing; headset validation pending. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.

patches_removed.name: Foveal blue-noise dithering (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Static blue-noise quantization after video colour processing and fade, only on the foveal layer. Accepts 8-bit or 10-bit input and always uses 8-bit sRGB output. Select independently or together with the other layer's blue-noise patch. Separate from OLED/VD-like processing; headset validation pending. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.

patches_removed.name: Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Exact Steam Link 2.0.20/5001812 experiment: copies only the foveal image onto a transparent 5000x6000 regular-GL canvas per eye and submits it as the 2nd projection. Preserves the original background projection and any existing static Surface-trigger quad. GPU allocation, runtime acceptance and resolution improvement require headset validation.

patches_added.description: Stops TikTok adding your new searches to the search history it saves on the phone. Searches you already made stay until you delete them, and this doesn't change what TikTok keeps on its servers. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications, the pushes about popular videos it picked for you. They're blocked from the start, and the switch lets them through again. Messages, comments, likes, follows and posts from accounts you follow aren't touched. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_added.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_added.description: Makes Facebook's native dark themes use pure-black AMOLED surfaces.

patches_added.name: Clean Home feed
patches_added.description: Hides Home Reels panels, the Stories tray, and exact recommendation feed units.

patches_added.name: De-Vanced Settings
patches_added.description: Adds De-Vanced controls to Facebook Profile Settings.

patches_added.name: Disable all ads
patches_added.description: Blocks Facebook sponsored feed units, Stories ads, Reels ads, Marketplace ads, and Instant Games/Audience Network ads.

patches_added.name: Disable analytics and telemetry
patches_added.description: Blocks Facebook Analytics2, Falco, Papaya, QPL, XAnalytics, crash/trace uploads, and attribution trackers.

patches_added.name: Disable auto refresh
patches_added.description: Keeps the current feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes.

patches_added.name: Download Media
patches_added.description: Adds a native-styled Download media action to Facebook Reels and Stories menus.

patches_added.name: Facebook signature compatibility
patches_added.description: Keeps Facebook first-party navigation working after signing with the established De-Vanced key.

patches_added.name: Material You theme
patches_added.description: Tints Facebook's dark theme with the phone's wallpaper palette.

patches_added.name: Media quality controls
patches_added.description: Applies De-Vanced resolution choices to Facebook Reels and video Stories.

patches_added.name: Messenger install compatibility
patches_added.description: Namespaces Facebook's shared signature permissions so official Messenger installs beside a re-signed Facebook build.

patches_added.name: Open Marketplace on launch
patches_added.description: Opens Marketplace when Facebook is started from its launcher icon.

patches_added.name: Optimize Facebook
patches_added.description: Suppresses explicit GC stalls, trims extension caches under memory pressure, and reduces render-time reflection.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: Extends Facebook picture-in-picture to every supported video surface.

patches_added.name: Reels 2x speed
patches_added.description: Adds hold-to-speed and slide-to-lock gestures for Shorts.

patches_removed.name: Hide story ads
patches_removed.description: Hides the ads in the Facebook app stories.

patches_added.name: Copy comment
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Copy action to the common comment menu. Copies the original text with its line breaks.

patches_added.name: Hide highlights
patches_added.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and the Add to highlight list on your stories stay.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_added.description: Leaves out the cards of people and creators to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_added.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts, posts and follower lists stay.

patches_added.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_added.description: Once you turn on Instagram's auto scroll in Reels, it stays on after Instagram restarts or you leave Reels, until you turn it off yourself.

patches_added.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_added.description: Keeps Instagram's seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Ads keep Instagram's own rules.

patches_added.name: Loop a story
patches_added.description: A story plays again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on.

patches_added.name: Save comment photo
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save action to the common comment menu when a comment has a photo of its own. It saves the largest size Instagram sent, the same way Download saves a post's photo.

patches_added.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_added.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted in its header, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_added.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_added.description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work.

patches_added.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_added.description: Keeps a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button and every other way into the camera still work.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own signature checks pass on a re-signed build, so the parts of the app that check who signed it keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key open from Instagram too, and Instagram trusts them when they share to it or ask it for your sign-in. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_added.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_added.description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops Telegram fetching link previews for messages you haven't sent yet, in chats, the share sheet, polls, story links and bot shares. Sent messages still get their preview.

patches_added.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_added.description: Adds a switch, off by default, that keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. Tapping the camera tile starts it.

patches_added.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_added.description: Hides Premium, Stars, My Grams, Business and Send a Gift in Settings, profile Gifts tabs and the channel Gift button. Purchases and account controls keep their usual behavior.

patches_added.name: Hide Stories
patches_added.description: Hides the chat-list story bar, avatar story rings and Post Story button, and stops fetching the story list. Profile stories and archives remain available.

patches_added.name: Hide popular apps
patches_added.description: Hides the Popular apps list in search's Apps tab and stops Telegram from asking its server for it. Apps you've opened and other search results stay.

patches_added.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_added.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners in the chat list. Account security notices and other suggestions remain. Nothing is dismissed for you.

patches_added.name: Hide recommendations
patches_added.description: Hides similar channels and bots, including cached recommendations. Telegram doesn't ask for new recommendations while the switch is on.

patches_added.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_added.description: Hides a proxy's sponsored channel from the chat list and folders. Leaves proxy settings and shared promo-data updates alone.

patches_added.name: Holiday look all year
patches_added.description: Adds a switch, off by default, that keeps Telegram's New Year snow falling all year over the chat list's top bar and chat backgrounds. Telegram's own holiday dates apply while it's off.

patches_added.name: Open links externally

patches_added.name: Quiet contacts nag

patches_added.name: Strip link tracking

patches_modified.name: Block promotional notifications
patches_modified.description: Keeps the kinds of notification you pick off your phone, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays. Each kind has its own switch, and they all start off. Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions and login alerts always come through.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides the Follow button on reels and the comment and reaction previews under them. Buttons such as Remix, Use template, Add yours and Stars go too, and each part has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Default comment order
patches_modified.description: Opens comments in the order you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. An order you pick in a post's comments stays for that post, and links to a comment still open on it.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Facebook picks as it plays. A quality you pick in a video's own menu still wins for that video.

patches_modified.name: Disable Audience Network
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched. It's used to rank your Reels feed, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back in the feed.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, below Facebook's own items. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI. Every switch starts off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections of Facebook's Menu. Each has its own switch. Settings, Help and support, your shortcuts and the rest of the Menu stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches_modified.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts Facebook adds to search results, and stops search suggestions from opening Meta AI by themselves. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still works.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts. The post, its link card and its buttons stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts in the news feed, and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends. A reel a friend posts stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories tray
patches_modified.description: Removes the row of stories at the top of the news feed, Create story included, and the rows of stories Facebook puts between posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches_modified.description: Removes the product cards of affiliate shop links from reels, feed posts and the comment sheet. The "Commission eligible" label stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide post prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less", who recently commented, or follow and chat suggestions, with no gap left behind. The post stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts by words
patches_modified.description: Hides feed posts whose text has a word or phrase you list, unless it also has one from your keep list. Hushfacebook never sends your words anywhere. The switch starts off, so turn it on and add words in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt from reels. The reel plays as usual.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results. The feed's request asks Facebook to leave them out and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. Ads that come back among search results are taken out before Marketplace shows them. The listings people post stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads between the posts on someone's profile or a Page. The profile's own posts stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches_modified.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, the sponsored posts and ad cards between the people, pages and posts you searched for.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches_modified.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches_modified.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads: "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know", suggested groups, "Stories you might like", "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too, and so does the "People you may know" row on your own profile. Each kind has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested in the Stories tray, and the tray's Find friends from contacts card. With Hide suggested and promoted posts in the build too, the tray's People you may know cards go as well. Your friends' stories, the Pages you follow and Create story stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches_modified.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens on its posts. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under News feed and restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats while Messenger is installed. Facebook only counts a Messenger signed with its own key, so a re-signed Facebook shows the card even with Messenger right there. Without Messenger the card stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video, off the tab bar, and its shortcut out of the long-press menu of Facebook's icon. Reel links and the reels in your feed still open. Facebook's own Hide in its tab bar settings keeps working, and a change to the switch shows once Facebook restarts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches_modified.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video. Every other tab keeps its own.

patches_modified.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches_modified.description: Holding a reel plays it at double speed until you let go. The hold takes the place of Facebook's long-press menu, which the reel's more button still opens.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy. The logo long press and the launcher shortcut still open the settings too.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook. Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, or Facebook's launcher icon, to turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches_modified.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install beside the patched Facebook. Facebook shares two permissions with them, and Android lets only one signing key own a permission, so this patch renames Facebook's. A Root Mount install doesn't need it.

patches_modified.name: Keep post dates
patches_modified.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name. Facebook's newer post header can swap that line for rotating details a moment after a post shows, and on some phones the line goes blank. With this on, the line stays put.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: A playback speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels until you pick another or Facebook restarts.

patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Gives Facebook's dark mode the colours of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Lets the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before, and a long press on the icon still does what Facebook does with it. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Chats in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser, without Facebook's click tracker or the fbclid tag it adds. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches_modified.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick in Hushfacebook's settings when you start it from its icon. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build, and lets a Messenger, Messenger Lite or Facebook Lite you patch with this build's own key sign in through it, the same as the real Meta app would. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags, such as mibextid, off the links you share or copy. The post or reel a link opens stays the same. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace it back to you.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Keeps Facebook from crashing or freezing as it starts on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an emulator or an x86 Chromebook, by skipping the one start-up step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips start as before.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each Story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Facebook's timing.

patches_modified.name: Stop update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook's own update prompts on a patched build, which can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update promotions and the push message that has it look for an update go, and so do chat promotions aimed at older versions.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Appearance and restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list. Photo tags and your text aren't touched.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. A tap plays as usual. While its switch is on, Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or a video from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still likes.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches_modified.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so the ones in posts, comments and chats look like the ones on your keyboard, big chat emoji included. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Restart Facebook after changing the switch.

patches_modified.name: Use the system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Facebook's own text in your phone's font instead of Meta's Optimistic typeface, or in a TrueType or OpenType file you pick in Hushfacebook's settings. Icons and emoji keep their fonts, and so does the text you put on a story. Restart Facebook after changing the font.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep the ring that marks them as new.

patches_modified.description: Holding a reel plays it at double speed until you let go. The hold takes the place of Facebook's long-press menu, which the reel's more button still opens.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy. The logo long press and the launcher shortcut still open the settings too.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook. Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, or Facebook's launcher icon, to turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches_modified.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install beside the patched Facebook. Facebook shares two permissions with them, and Android lets only one signing key own a permission, so this patch renames Facebook's. A Root Mount install doesn't need it.

patches_modified.name: Keep post dates
patches_modified.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name. Facebook's newer post header can swap that line for rotating details a moment after a post shows, and on some phones the line goes blank. With this on, the line stays put.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: A playback speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels until you pick another or Facebook restarts.

patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Gives Facebook's dark mode the colours of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Lets the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before, and a long press on the icon still does what Facebook does with it. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Chats in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser, without Facebook's click tracker or the fbclid tag it adds. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches_modified.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches_modified.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick in Hushfacebook's settings when you start it from its icon. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build, and lets a Messenger, Messenger Lite or Facebook Lite you patch with this build's own key sign in through it, the same as the real Meta app would. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags, such as mibextid, off the links you share or copy. The post or reel a link opens stays the same. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace it back to you.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Keeps Facebook from crashing or freezing as it starts on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an emulator or an x86 Chromebook, by skipping the one start-up step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips start as before.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each Story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Facebook's timing.

patches_modified.name: Stop update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook's own update prompts on a patched build, which can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update promotions and the push message that has it look for an update go, and so do chat promotions aimed at older versions.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Appearance and restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches_modified.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list. Photo tags and your text aren't touched.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. A tap plays as usual. While its switch is on, Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or a video from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still likes.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches_modified.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so the ones in posts, comments and chats look like the ones on your keyboard, big chat emoji included. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Restart Facebook after changing the switch.

patches_modified.name: Use the system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Facebook's own text in your phone's font instead of Meta's Optimistic typeface, or in a TrueType or OpenType file you pick in Hushfacebook's settings. Icons and emoji keep their fonts, and so does the text you put on a story. Restart Facebook after changing the font.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep the ring that marks them as new.

patches_added.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_added.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Threads within ten minutes, or after any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still load new posts.

patches_added.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_added.description: Videos in feed posts don't play by themselves as you scroll. Tap one to watch it full screen.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested users
patches_added.description: Removes verified server cards suggesting accounts to follow. Ordinary posts, reposts and unknown card types stay.

patches_added.name: Open links in browser
patches_added.description: Opens the web links you tap in your default browser instead of Threads' own, without Threads' click tracker. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Redirects matched Pigeon, default event-log and MQTT analytics addresses. Settings show which address kinds were patched. Other telemetry may remain.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Threads sending its usage analytics and event logs to Meta. Everything the app needs to work is left alone.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Takes sponsored posts out of your Threads feed before they're shown.

patches_modified.name: HushThreads settings
patches_modified.description: Adds HushThreads settings to Threads. Long-press Threads' launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Threads' App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads getting your phone's advertising ID from Google Play services. Threads gets a string of zeros in its place.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Threads trust itself again on a re-signed build, the way it trusts its Meta-signed self, and lets an Instagram you patch with this build's own key call into it the same as the real Instagram would. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_modified.description: Takes Threads' tracking tags, such as xmt, off the links you share or copy, and turns a short share link into the post's own link. The post a link opens stays the same.

patches_added.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications, the pushes about popular videos it picked for you. They're blocked from the start, and the switch lets them through again. Messages, comments, likes, follows and posts from accounts you follow aren't touched. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_added.name: Feed text sizes
patches_added.description: Sets independent sizes for video descriptions and creator names. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_added.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_added.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders. TikTok's server decides what goes in that row, so the checklist offers the ones it has sent to your phone, and you can also type names. Restart TikTok after a change. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Stop saving search history
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok adding your new searches to the search history it saves on the phone. Searches you already made stay until you delete them, and this doesn't change what TikTok keeps on its servers. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, including videos with creator commission disclosures, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labeled videos, location-tagged videos, verified accounts, series, mini dramas, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from, the language of their original caption and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. A short list of creator exceptions lets chosen accounts through the filters on the kind of post, its labels, age, length and counts. Ads, blocked creators, words, sounds, countries and caption languages, paid and Shop content, LIVE and seen videos still apply to them. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded and the ads a creator's video pager asks for on its own. The share prompt that appears after a like can be hidden too, and so can TikTok Shop's Products block and product cards in search results. The LIVE feed you swipe through has its own rules: gaming, shopping, sponsored and verified LIVEs, categories, and viewer and follower ranges. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

The share prompt that appears after a like can be hidden too, and so can TikTok Shop's Products block and product cards in search results. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Records CAPTCHA decisions and preserves TikTok's verification dialogs. The existing hide switch is unavailable on the declared builds because no browsing scene has been validated. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a default-off setting to hide the CAPTCHA dialogs raised while browsing or watching LIVE. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any CAPTCHA the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Records TikTok's BdTuring risk-control decisions through the shared CAPTCHA gate. All verification dialogs remain visible because no browsing scene has been validated. Off by default.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search. The status bar can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. One more takes the Add comment bar off those opened videos so they fill the screen. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, which can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends one message a day to each person you pick, at a time you pick, so message streaks with them keep going on days you don't open TikTok. The message goes through TikTok's own notification reply. Adds the exact alarm and start at boot permissions the daily alarm needs. Off until you turn it on: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends one message a day to a person you pick, at a time you pick, so a message streak with them keeps going on days you don't open TikTok. The message goes through TikTok's own notification reply. Adds the exact alarm and start at boot permissions the daily alarm needs. Off until you turn it on: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Empties the TikTok language bundles you leave out of Languages to keep, always keeping English. It keeps every language until you list the ones you want, so picking every patch removes none. Listed codes are checked before any file changes. Keeping only English saves about 26 MB of storage.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes. With the default choices it saves about 26 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. A second switch, off by default, keeps TikTok's phone benchmark from starting in a background process of its own. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Ad-Free & Unlock Animated Step Solutions - Photomath (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Blocks ads and unlocks deep step-by-step animated explanations, textbook geometry solutions, and calculation tips in Photomath.

patches_modified.name: Spicetify Custom Accent Color - Spotify (Experimental)
patches_modified.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Replaces Spotify brand green (#1DB954 / #1ED760) with custom Cyberpunk Electric Purple (#8A2BE2) across obfuscated bytecode, string tables, and color models.

patches_added.name: 120 FPS Smooth Radar Animations - Windy.com (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Forces 120Hz display refresh rate and unlocks high-framerate wind particle simulations and smooth satellite weather animation layers in Windy.

patches_added.name: 200% Volume Boost & Audio Gain - VLC (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks 200% volume amplification (software preamp gain up to +12dB) for low-volume videos/audio and prevents volume ducking on notifications.

patches_added.name: Background Playback & Universal PIP - VLC (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Forces background audio playback and automatic Picture-in-Picture (PIP) for all videos and audio streams when switching apps or minimizing VLC.

patches_added.name: Allow Screenshots & Screen Recording - Proton Pass (Experimental)

patches_added.name: Unlock Pro Vaults & 2FA Authenticator - Proton Pass (Experimental)

patches_modified.name: AMOLED Dark Theme & Privacy - Undercover (Experimental)

patches_modified.name: Unlock All Word Packs & Premium - Undercover (Experimental)

Select independently or together with the other layer's blue-noise patch. Separate from OLED/VD-like processing; headset validation pending. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.

patches_added.name: Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)
patches_added.description: Exact Steam Link 2.0.20/5001812 experiment: copies only the foveal image onto a transparent 5000x6000 regular-GL canvas per eye and submits it as the 2nd projection. Preserves the original background projection and any existing static Surface-trigger quad. GPU allocation, runtime acceptance and resolution improvement require headset validation.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays

The status bar can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. One more takes the Add comment bar off those opened videos so they fill the screen. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Empties the TikTok language bundles you leave out of Languages to keep, always keeping English. patches_modified.previous_description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes. With the default choices it saves about 26 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. A second switch, off by default, keeps TikTok's phone benchmark from starting in a background process of its own. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups

patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a default-off setting to hide the CAPTCHA dialogs raised while browsing or watching LIVE. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any CAPTCHA the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Records TikTok's BdTuring risk-control decisions through the shared CAPTCHA gate. All verification dialogs remain visible because no browsing scene has been validated. Off by default.

Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends one message a day to each person you pick, at a time you pick, so message streaks with them keep going on days you don't open TikTok. The message goes through TikTok's own notification reply. Adds the exact alarm and start at boot permissions the daily alarm needs. Off until you turn it on: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sends one message a day to a person you pick, at a time you pick, so a message streak with them keeps going on days you don't open TikTok. The message goes through TikTok's own notification reply. Adds the exact alarm and start at boot permissions the daily alarm needs. Off until you turn it on: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_added.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_added.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders. TikTok's server decides what goes in that row, so the checklist offers the ones it has sent to your phone, and you can also type names. Restart TikTok after a change. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Feed text sizes
patches_added.description: Sets independent sizes for video descriptions and creator names. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search. The status bar can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. One more takes the Add comment bar off those opened videos so they fill the screen. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, which can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Empties the TikTok language bundles you leave out of Languages to keep, always keeping English. It keeps every language until you list the ones you want, so picking every patch removes none. Listed codes are checked before any file changes. Keeping only English saves about 26 MB of storage.
patches_modified.previous_description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes. With the default choices it saves about 26 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. A second switch, off by default, keeps TikTok's phone benchmark from starting in a background process of its own. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Records CAPTCHA decisions and preserves TikTok's verification dialogs. The existing hide switch is unavailable on the declared builds because no browsing scene has been validated. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a default-off setting to hide the CAPTCHA dialogs raised while browsing or watching LIVE. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any CAPTCHA the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Records TikTok's BdTuring risk-control decisions through the shared CAPTCHA gate. All verification dialogs remain visible because no browsing scene has been validated. Off by default.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hill Climb Racing Ad Removal
patches_modified.description: Removes all ads — banner and pop-up ads never show, and the game treats you as ad-free from the start without any repeat purchase pop-ups.
patches_modified.previous_description: Completely removes ads: banners and interstitials can never be displayed (CFirebaseAds.showBanners/showInterstitial become no-ops) and ad-free is granted once per app start — loadStore() seeds mAdFree = 1, the native engine's poll grants it and the store's own reset (inappPurchasesProcessed) zeroes the field, so no repeated purchase popups.

patches_modified.name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store
patches_modified.description: Everything in the store is free — coins, gems, paints and bundles are added instantly with no Google Play payment.
patches_modified.previous_description: Every store item is granted instantly and free: coins, gems, paints, ad-skips, ad-free and bundles, without launching Google Play billing.

patches_modified.name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards
patches_modified.description: Rewarded ads pay out instantly — no video plays; the game gives you the reward as if you had watched the whole ad.
patches_modified.previous_description: Rewarded video ads grant their reward instantly without playing the ad: the native engine receives onVideoStartedSuccess + onVideoCompletedSuccess on the GL thread, exactly as if the video had been watched and completed.

patches_modified.name: Only One Free Store

patches_modified.name: Only One IAP billing bypass
patches_modified.description: Buy any item in the shop for free. When you tap Buy, the item is added to your game right away — no Google Play payment window ever opens.

patches_modified.name: Only One PairIP removal
patches_modified.description: Disables the PairIP license check so the game starts without Google Play licensing, error dialogs or forced exits.

patches_modified.name: Free store
patches_modified.description: The in-game store is free. Just tap "Buy" and the item is yours — no payment needed. For an ad-free game, just buy the ad-block item from the store.

patches_modified.description:
Example overlay addon for Hill Climb Racing (com.fingersoft.hillclimb), used together with UniPatches Universal Overlay.
        It adds six safe, mock-only app-specific preview modules to the shared overlay: A
        - Add Coins
        - Add Gems
        - Add Paints 
        - Vehicle Selection
        - Stage Selection
        - Garage Selection.

patches_added.name: Keep post dates
patches_added.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name. Facebook's newer post header can swap that line for rotating details a moment after a post shows, and on some phones the line goes blank. With this on, the line stays put.

patches_added.name: Start on x86 devices

Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.

patches_modified.name: Keep Titanium Extensions Child Processes Alive
patches_modified.description: Experimental version-unpinned structural/data-flow patch: starts one main-process foreground service with persistent low-priority notification and forces child STRONG binding plus IMPORTANT/STRONG priority updates. Tolerates routine signature, register, and helper-name changes; ambiguous targets fail closed. May increase RAM, battery, and process pressure; mitigates LMK kills only. To hide the notification, use Android Settings > Apps > Titanium > Notifications (the keep-alive service stays active either way).
patches_modified.previous_description: Experimental version-unpinned structural/data-flow patch: starts one main-process foreground service with persistent low-priority notification and forces STRONG binding plus IMPORTANT priority only for extension child processes (detected via --extension-process, matching upstream Titanium commit ff12f1c). Renderer and GPU children keep stock priority, so RAM and battery pressure stay closer to baseline. Tolerates routine signature, register, and helper-name changes; ambiguous targets fail closed. Mitigates LMK kills only. To hide the notification, use Android Settings > Apps > Titanium > Notifications (the keep-alive service stays active either way).

patches_modified.name: Stop requests to dead servers
patches_modified.description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers. If the OBB is missing, the game says why.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.

patches_removed.name: Swipe up diagnostic (temporary)
patches_removed.description: Diagnostic build only. After each upward swipe, types what the detector measured: u<rise>/<drift>s<samples>=<outcome><when>, with rise and drift in dp. 6 means it would count as a swipe up, 2 means too short, 3 means too diagonal; a trailing m or e says whether that was reached mid-swipe or only at release. It only reports: it does not undo anything and does not stop the key being typed. Needs Swipe Left to Delete enabled. Off by default, and this patch will be removed once it has answered its question.
