patches_modified.description: Keeps a local record of the videos you have watched and hides them when the feed sends them again. The record never leaves the device and can be cleared from settings. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that plays over the comment sheet when a comment matches an advertiser's trigger word or emoji. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides automatic emoji and sticker suggestions above the comment box. Manual buttons stay available. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds. Shares its switch with the LIVE entrance option of Hide video overlays, and stops the button before it is built rather than hiding it once it is on screen. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Hide the save button from video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Hide the search button at the top right of video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges from the feed and can hide the rewards shortcut on Profile. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen and App.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the stories tray at the top of the Inbox and restores it immediately when the switch is turned off. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone. A separate switch hides the search rewards banner and coin counter some regions get. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages, and collapses every other People you may like card: the profile header, the Friends tab and the feed. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that opens on pressing and holding TikTok's icon on the home screen. The entries are built while the app runs rather than declared in it, and TikTok only rewrites them when it notices a difference, so this removes what is already published and answers the handover that would publish more. Turning it off asks TikTok to build them again. Tapping the icon still opens the app, and a shortcut pinned to a home screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, which can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, which can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's own hold, pull down and release gesture to lock the hold speed, 2x unless Playback speed sets another. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Keeps TikTok's JavaScript bridge off external pages in its in-app browser while leaving Activity center, Watch history, shop checkout and CAPTCHA working. The switch is off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab on your profile when TikTok's server puts the account into an experiment that empties it. Two people saw that after patching: the tab was there and the saved videos were not. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate and skips its push initialization task. Videos may start buffering later, and TikTok push notifications may stop.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Answers TikTok's location requests with nothing: the last known location comes back empty and update requests never fire. The SIM and region spoof change the locale and timezone, not the coordinates. This patch stops the coordinates. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, copy the link to the video or its sound, or look the sound up on YouTube Music. It can also turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward, and make a long press on Comment, Share or Favorites play at the hold speed instead of opening TikTok's menu. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Mute feed videos
patches_modified.description: Adds a movable button that mutes feed videos without touching the phone's volume, and a switch that does the same. The button also shows on a video opened from a profile, a hashtag or a sound, and mutes that one too. While muted, music from another app keeps playing, and DMs, stories and LIVE keep their sound. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok's own API client sends, by domain and kind, and adds them to the diagnostic export. Video and image downloads and other companies' SDKs keep their own connections and aren't counted. Nothing about the requests is changed.

patches_modified.name: Not interested button
patches_modified.description: Adds a movable button that tells TikTok you aren't interested in the current video. It hides while comments are open. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. The follower switch drops the notification before Android is asked to post it, so nothing else in the drawer is affected. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Selects the lowest, highest or a target video quality for playback, adaptive streams included. A second choice caps quality on mobile data and only ever lowers it. Download quality has its own setting. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers playback speed or applies a default to each new video, with custom menu choices up to 3x and your own speed for the hold gesture. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Matches locale, timezone and native region getters to the SIM preset, with a separate experimental store-region switch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers clear display between videos, or enters it automatically after a chosen delay. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop. The APK gets about 3 MB smaller.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA and Microblink card-scanning assets, the Pitaya AI model libraries, the live-cast dynamic feature, and the ART log monitor probe. Saves about 12.5 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. The Create tab and all recording, editing and effects tools stop working. Saves about 40 MB of storage. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes. With the default choices it saves about 26 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, records a repost request, TikTok's answer, and the next repost-list read without recording the video's ID or note.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared, and can put a host of your choosing in place of tiktok.com. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings screen to TikTok and keeps its entry first in Settings and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Asks twice before a video is sent to a friend from the share sheet. The check follows the account or conversation instead of the visible name and covers accessibility actions and keyboard input. It can also hide chosen people, share options or the whole Send to row, and a profile's or a LIVE's share sheet can hide a different set from a video's. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the LIVE drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Show the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name on the feed. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden, including when one of TikTok's experiments takes it off every video but paid content. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's splash-ad preload tasks and returns false from its reviewed splash and TopView gates. Other startup behavior is left in place.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's background and boot-finished device-ID update-check tasks. This may suppress some in-app update checks. Play Store updates are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: Keeps TikTok's full-screen viewer on a video when it ends instead of moving to the next one, and leaves out its next-video countdown. Swiping still moves on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Kills the Pitaya on-device ML inference engine at startup so it cannot build a behavioral profile. The AI asset strip in the core de-bloat patch removes the native libraries. This patch stops the initialization code that would download replacements.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Saves subtitle files beside downloaded videos and adds caption size, background, and clear-display options. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a feed video do nothing or open its comments instead of opening the creator's profile. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws TikTok's text in your device's font instead of TikTok Sans. The icons, the gift animations and the @ and # glyphs keep their own fonts. Off by default. Restart after changing. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_added.description: Keeps TikTok's own background play on, whatever its server says, so the video you're watching keeps playing after you leave the app or turn the screen off, and TikTok's media notification pauses and resumes it. It also covers photo posts and the videos on your own profile, private ones included, which TikTok leaves out. A feed video plays to its end, because TikTok doesn't loop or move on in the feed while it's in the background, and another app's sound still pauses it. TikTok's own background play switch in the long-press menu stays on while this is on. Off by default. Restart TikTok after changing it. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Replaces TikTok's dark background palette with black or a chosen color. The light theme keeps its colors. It rewrites TikTok's resources, so patching with it on is slower when the manager's memory limit is low. Give the manager 768 MB or more. At 640 MB it still finishes, just more slowly.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds download quality choices, original Photo Mode images, separate audio files and optional video details. It can check for an existing saved video before downloading another copy. Long presses save profile pictures and stories. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Ignores the creator's Duet and Stitch setting so the entries appear for videos that closed them. Everything else the app checks still applies: a photo post, a private video or one with music it may not reuse is still refused, and whether the upload is accepted is the server's decision, not the app's. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Removes secure window flags and disables the Circle to Search block. Off by default. Restart after changing. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Automatic video advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps TikTok's automatic advance enabled while preserving its pause, dialog and gesture checks, and shows TikTok's own Auto scroll action in the video panel for accounts outside its rollout, with a switch that hides that action instead. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Strips TikTok's peer-to-peer CDN libraries so your phone is not used as a relay node for other people's video traffic. The APK gets about 3.5 MB smaller.

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds one-tap controls for blocking the creator, hiding them locally and blocking the current sound. A confirmed account block skips to the next video and shows a small Unblock button at the top left for two seconds. The local-hide and sound controls have separate switches. Long press any visible control to move it. Hushfeed keeps it clear of system bars, cutouts and TikTok's bottom tabs when the window changes. A local action shows Undo only after its setting was saved. All controls hide while comments are open. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Answers TikTok's reads of your phone contacts with an empty list. Find Friends and People you may know lose access to your contact list. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Answers TikTok's scan of the apps installed on your phone with an empty list. Checks for one named app, which TikTok also uses to open an app you tap, are left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok has the camera open or is recording sound. A green square for the camera, an orange diamond for the microphone, both when both. It goes when the access ends. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Says in the diagnostic report whether a comment send reached TikTok's publish code, what it had in hand, and whether it returned early or handed the comment to the request. A comment that never posts leaves no other trace.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Sends comments TikTok would drop without a word. TikTok checks a send against the most recently opened page, and when that page has already lost its screen it stops the comment and shows nothing. This checks it against the comment panel's own screen instead.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's own comment sort sheet on every post, with its hot, newest, media and creator options, instead of the cut-down row an account outside the rollout is given. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments that contain chosen words or come from chosen accounts, turns the thumbs down on each comment into a block button that shows the block symbol, makes links tappable, can show a poll's results before you vote and can hide pictures, polls or TikTok's suggested-search banner above comments. Compact comment header removes the count, controls and suggestion space above the list. Easier comment likes extends the heart's touch area into nearby blank space without changing row spacing. A separate search box filters comments already loaded on the video. Tapping more under a video can open its comments with the caption at the top, and the comment button can open them that way too. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which opens the comments. Each tool has its own switch in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches_modified.description: Asks for a second tap before the feed Follow button, the like heart, a comment or story like, or a quick repost goes through. A short message asks for the second tap, and most armed buttons also get a white ring. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Blocks TikTok from reading your clipboard. Copying a link you asked for still works. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds diagnostic logging, filtered reports and local TikTok crash capture. The switches are under Diagnostics in Hushfeed settings. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch on the Privacy page that stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, explicit Firebase screen reports and TikTok's Npth or MonitorCrash startup reporting. TikTok's own diagnostics go quiet with them. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap controls
patches_modified.description: Lets double taps do nothing or open the current video's comments. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates. It ignores the flag TikTok sets when a creator turns downloading off, so those videos save too. Network fetches accept public HTTPS addresses and follow at most five checked redirects. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's reviewed Fresco animated-frame cache lookups return no cached frame. This can increase decoding work or change animation playback.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own voice comment recording and publishing entry points for accounts that do not have them.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Show the full Activity and New followers lists instead of collapsing them behind a View all button. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records feature gate reads while you use TikTok and compares them with their previous values. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, including videos with creator commission disclosures, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labeled videos, location-tagged videos, verified accounts, series, mini dramas, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from, the language of their original caption and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. A short list of creator exceptions lets chosen accounts through the filters on the kind of post, its labels, age, length and counts. Ads, blocked creators, words, sounds, countries and caption languages, paid and Shop content, LIVE and seen videos still apply to them. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded and the ads a creator's video pager asks for on its own. The share prompt that appears after a like can be hidden too, and so can TikTok Shop's Products block and product cards in search results. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, can hide the Following and For You names above the feed while swiping between them keeps working, can hide the Tako AI bubble and the unread badges on the bottom tabs, can keep For You from reloading on a Home tap or a pull down, brings TikTok's LIVE button back to the feed's corner when the LIVE tab is taken off either bar, can open TikTok on Following, Friends, Inbox or Profile, can show TikTok's own feed buttons without a screen reader, and opens Hushfeed's settings from a long press on Home. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Puts the whole of a vertical video on screen instead of cropping it to the window. On a 9:16 phone nothing changes, because the video already fills it. On a Fold opened up, a squarer phone or a split view the sides or the ends stop being cut off. A second switch, Fill the screen with the video, does the opposite and crops the video until it covers the screen, for the phones where TikTok leaves a black strip under a 9:16 video. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: Shows comments beside the video on windows wider than a configurable threshold. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Reads what the server said about a follow. A follow TikTok turns down comes back looking like a success, so this reports the refusal and its reason once per session and, with diagnostic logging on, writes the whole exchange to the report.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Block hooked story, profile and typing reports. The switch shows local activity and retains a warning after a known story-reporting failure. Viewer-list privacy still needs a two-account check. Online status is unchanged. Switch and diagnostics: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide the CAPTCHA dialogs raised while browsing or watching LIVE. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any CAPTCHA the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Gives the patched APK the highest Android version code so Play shows Open instead of Update. TikTok's visible version stays the same in Morphe Manager. Off by default. Android won't install a lower-code APK over it, and uninstalling to return to a lower code can remove local TikTok data.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Keeps a local record of the videos you have watched and hides them when the feed sends them again. The record never leaves the device and can be cleared from settings. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that plays over the comment sheet when a comment matches an advertiser's trigger word or emoji. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides automatic emoji and sticker suggestions above the comment box. Manual buttons stay available. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds. Shares its switch with the LIVE entrance option of Hide video overlays, and stops the button before it is built rather than hiding it once it is on screen. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Hide the save button from video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Hide the search button at the top right of video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges from the feed and can hide the rewards shortcut on Profile. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen and App.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the stories tray at the top of the Inbox and restores it immediately when the switch is turned off. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone. A separate switch hides the search rewards banner and coin counter some regions get. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages, and collapses every other People you may like card: the profile header, the Friends tab and the feed. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that opens on pressing and holding TikTok's icon on the home screen. The entries are built while the app runs rather than declared in it, and TikTok only rewrites them when it notices a difference, so this removes what is already published and answers the handover that would publish more. Turning it off asks TikTok to build them again. Tapping the icon still opens the app, and a shortcut pinned to a home screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, which can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, which can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's own hold, pull down and release gesture to lock the hold speed, 2x unless Playback speed sets another. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Keeps TikTok's JavaScript bridge off external pages in its in-app browser while leaving Activity center, Watch history, shop checkout and CAPTCHA working. The switch is off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab on your profile when TikTok's server puts the account into an experiment that empties it. Two people saw that after patching: the tab was there and the saved videos were not. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate and skips its push initialization task. Videos may start buffering later, and TikTok push notifications may stop.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Answers TikTok's location requests with nothing: the last known location comes back empty and update requests never fire. The SIM and region spoof change the locale and timezone, not the coordinates. This patch stops the coordinates. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, copy the link to the video or its sound, or look the sound up on YouTube Music. It can also turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward, and make a long press on Comment, Share or Favorites play at the hold speed instead of opening TikTok's menu. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Mute feed videos
patches_modified.description: Adds a movable button that mutes feed videos without touching the phone's volume, and a switch that does the same. The button also shows on a video opened from a profile, a hashtag or a sound, and mutes that one too. While muted, music from another app keeps playing, and DMs, stories and LIVE keep their sound. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok's own API client sends, by domain and kind, and adds them to the diagnostic export. Video and image downloads and other companies' SDKs keep their own connections and aren't counted. Nothing about the requests is changed.

patches_modified.name: Not interested button

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display

patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop. The APK gets about 3 MB smaller.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA and Microblink card-scanning assets, the Pitaya AI model libraries, the live-cast dynamic feature, and the ART log monitor probe. Saves about 12.5 MB of storage.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. The Create tab and all recording, editing and effects tools stop working. Saves about 40 MB of storage. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof

patches_modified.name: Show author region

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features in JellyWatch TV. Premium entitlement is server-verified against verify.jellywatch.app and surfaced to the UI as a PremiumStatus data class (isPremium = first boolean field); the patch forces that field to true and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Edge
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_added.name: Comment Sort Controls
patches_added.description: Unlocks TikTok's native comment sorting menu (Hot, Newest, Creator only, With media) across all posts.

patches_added.name: Disable Search Video Autoplay
patches_added.description: Disables automatic video playback in search results. Videos only play when tapped to view in detail.

patches_added.name: Hide Nearby Feed Tab
patches_added.description: Removes the Nearby (local city or region) feed tab from the top navigation feed strip.

patches_added.name: Hide Seen Videos
patches_added.description: Filters previously watched videos from incoming For You feed batches.

patches_added.name: Resume Video After Scroll
patches_added.description: Remembers playback timestamp when scrolling away and resumes from where playback stopped upon returning.

patches_added.name: Stop Video Looping
patches_added.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them in an infinite loop.

patches_modified.name: Always Show Publish Date
patches_modified.description: Forces video publish/upload date to remain visible in video author information across all feed types.

patches_modified.name: Auto-Pause First Video
patches_modified.description: Automatically pauses the first video when opening TikTok, allowing the application to finish background initialization and preventing playback lag.

patches_modified.name: Auto-Translate Comments
patches_modified.description: Automatically translates comments into your preferred language using TikTok's native translation engine.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Mandatory Login
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes mandatory login walls, dynamic regional forced login gates, and guest browsing restrictions.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Screen Capture Detection
patches_modified.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE on protected windows to allow screenshots and screen recording across restricted views, and neutralizes screenshot detection listeners and feedback prompts.

patches_modified.name: Clean Share URL
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links.

patches_modified.name: Client-Side AI & Behavioral Profiling Governor
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes on-device machine learning inference (Pitaya), Tako AI chatbot entry points and icons, and AI smart search suggestion clutter.

patches_modified.name: Copy Comments Without Username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without prepending the author username.

patches_modified.name: Core Asset De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips embedded Microblink/FinTech card scanner models, Pitaya AI & ByteNN LLM engines, C2PA origin verification, DLNA cast scanners, and redundant non-Latin fonts to save APK space.

patches_modified.name: Custom Offline Videos Limit
patches_modified.description: Customizes the maximum number of videos available for offline download caching.

patches_modified.name: Custom Share Sheet
patches_modified.description: Customizes and cleans the native TikTok share sheet via individual toggle switches for third-party apps, essential sharing features, and secondary utility actions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes and simplifies the native TikTok share sheet by removing third-party app bloat, hiding specified apps or actions, and optionally suppressing the friends/contacts direct message row.

patches_modified.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions (contacts sync, location tracking, nearby devices), advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.

patches_modified.name: Disable Comment Suggested Emojis
patches_modified.description: Removes the horizontal bar of suggested quick emojis displayed above the comment input box.

patches_modified.name: Disable Double Tap to Like
patches_modified.description: Disables the double tap gesture to like videos in the feed, preventing accidental likes while scrolling or pausing. Videos can still be liked using the like button.

patches_modified.name: Disable Profile Photo LIVE Status
patches_modified.description: Removes the pulsing LIVE ring and badge from creator avatars in the feed and ensures clicking navigates strictly to the user profile instead of launching the live stream.

patches_modified.name: Disable Push Notifications
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes background push notification tasks and persistent socket wake locks to eliminate background battery drain.

patches_modified.name: Disable Search History Recording
patches_modified.description: Prevents search queries and keywords from being recorded in local history, databases, and analytics stores.

patches_modified.name: Disable Story Feed Indicators
patches_modified.description: Removes creator profile photo story rings from feed videos, ensuring avatar photos remain clean without blue story rings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the top-center story drop-down indicator pill (e.g. '1 Story') and creator profile photo story rings from feed videos, ensuring avatar photos remain clean.

patches_modified.name: Disable Watch History Recording
patches_modified.description: Prevents viewed videos from being recorded in account watch history, playback duration stores, and local history caches.

patches_modified.name: Display Refresh Rate Governor
patches_modified.description: Forces TikTok to run at peak display refresh rate (120Hz/90Hz/60Hz) and neutralizes video playback framerate downclocking routines.

patches_modified.name: Enable Voice Comments
patches_modified.description: Forces the native voice comment recording button in comment input bars, bypassing regional rollout restrictions and remote server blocks.

patches_modified.name: Feed Ad Blocker
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You, Following, and Search feeds.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You and Following feeds.

patches_modified.name: Feed Bloat & Distraction Blocker
patches_modified.description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You, Following, and Friends feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), surveys, and mini-drama paywalls.

patches_modified.name: Feed Live Stream Blocker
patches_modified.description: Removes live stream broadcast cards and live recommendations from the For You and Following feeds.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google Login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching by forcing fallback to Web-based OAuth when Google Play Services rejects the modified APK signature.

patches_modified.name: Force Auto-Scroll
patches_modified.description: Forces the activation of the native video auto-scroll experiment flag for accounts and regions that lack it due to A/B testing.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-Generated Content
patches_modified.description: Filters and skips videos tagged with native AI-generated metadata, C2PA content credentials, or creator AI disclosure tags across the For You, Following, and Friends feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide Community Tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Community (Explore) tab from the top navigation feed strip.

patches_modified.name: Hide Feed Search Bar
patches_modified.description: Removes the search suggestion pill and trending bar ('Search · <keyword>') from the bottom of feed videos, providing a clean viewing area without search distractions.

patches_modified.name: Hide Popular Lives In Search
patches_modified.description: Removes the Popular LIVEs recommendation card and live stream broadcasts from the search discovery page.

patches_modified.name: Hide Profile Photo Follow Button
patches_modified.description: Hides the plus (+) follow badge on creator profile avatars in the feed and disables its touch interaction.

patches_modified.name: Hide Suggested Searches
patches_modified.description: Removes the suggested search keywords section ('You may like' / 'Search suggestions') from the search discovery page.

patches_modified.name: Hide TikTok Shop & Mall
patches_modified.description: Removes product showcase badges, shopping cart tags, and the TikTok Shop / Mall tab from navigation bars and video posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide Top-Left LIVE Button
patches_modified.description: Removes the top-left LIVE broadcast button and tab entry point from the top navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: In-App Browser Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Redirects external and third-party web links to the default system browser and neutralizes inline JavaScript tracking, DOM monitoring, and AJAX hooking in residual in-app WebViews.

patches_modified.name: Instant Launch & Splash Blocker
patches_modified.description: Eliminates cold startup delays, background resume splash advertisements, real-time splash requests, and TopView ad preloading.
patches_modified.previous_description: Eliminates cold startup delays, real-time splash advertisements, and background TopView ad preloading.

patches_modified.name: Language Pack Purger
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language string bundles from assets/strings#lang_* to save APK space.

patches_modified.name: Live Stream 3D Gift Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Disables Live 3D gift particle effect engine and widget rendering lifecycle to eliminate frame drops during live streams.

patches_modified.name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), and live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint.

patches_modified.name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader
patches_modified.description: Unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos inside the Share panel, and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.

patches_modified.name: P2P Video Relay & Mesh CDN Blocker
patches_modified.description: Strips background Peer-to-Peer CDN distribution binaries (libavmdlp2pv2.so and libp2plivevdp.so) to prevent battery drain, background data upload, and mesh relay.

patches_modified.name: Playback Speed Persistence
patches_modified.description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts.

patches_modified.name: Resource & Battery Governor
patches_modified.description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads) and prevents aggressive video buffer preloading to conserve battery and CPU resources.

patches_modified.name: SIM Region Selector
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.

patches_modified.name: Show Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Restores TikTok's native video seekbar and scrubbing controls where normally hidden or disabled.

patches_modified.name: Skip First-Launch Onboarding
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the entire first-run introduction funnel (interest pickers, swipe tutorials, language prompts, and consent sheets) directly to the feed.

patches_modified.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.

patches_modified.name: Update Prompt Suppressor
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.

patches_modified.name: Video Quality Governor
patches_modified.description: Caps video playback and download resolutions (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) independently to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data.

patches_added.name: Player icon style
patches_added.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_added.name: Player icon style
patches_added.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_modified.name: Big Hunter Fake Purchase
patches_modified.description: Tapping any store item grants the product immediately (via the game's own confirmed-purchase path -> native applyProduct) without opening Google Play billing. Entitlements persist across restarts.

patches_modified.name: Big Hunter PairIP License Bypass
patches_modified.description: Disables the PairIP license check (installer verification + Google Play licensing service validation + paywall/exit dialog). Required for patched APKs — the original check fails on any non-Play signature and force-closes the app.

patches_modified.name: Big Hunter Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Interstitial ads are never shown (show() short-circuits via the ad-not-ready path on all three network bridges: AdMob, AppLovin, Unity Ads).

patches_modified.name: Big Hunter Rewards Without Ads
patches_modified.description: Rewarded video requests grant the reward immediately via the game's own native rewardCallback() without loading or showing any ad (AdMob, AppLovin, Unity Ads).

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features and disables premium prompts.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Remove Banner Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes AppLovin banner ads and the Ndemic premium promo during gameplay.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Skip Rewarded Video Ads
patches_modified.description: Grants rewarded video bonuses instantly without watching ads.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Sync Premium Entitlements
patches_modified.description: Registers unlocked premium content with the native engine so premium modes run without trial banners.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Unlock All Genes
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all genes by earning them through the game's own unlock path when the gene menu opens.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Unlock Disease Types
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all disease types including Neurax Worm, Necroa Virus, Simian Flu and Shadow Plague.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Unlock Expansions
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Cure Mode, Plague Pack, custom scenarios and bypasses the Play Pass check.

patches_modified.name: Plague Inc. Unlock Fast-Forward
patches_modified.description: Removes the premium lock from the in-game fast-forward button.

patches_modified.name: Earn to Die 2 Free IAP
patches_modified.description: Intercepts all in-app purchases and calls the native on_purchase(String[], String) grant directly, unlocking paid content (cash doubler) for free without Play Billing.
patches_modified.previous_description: Intercepts all in-app purchases and reports instant success to the game engine, unlocking paid content (cash doubler) for free.

patches_modified.name: Earn to Die 2 No Ads + Instant Rewards
patches_modified.description: Removes interstitial and rewarded ads, and grants rewarded-video rewards instantly by firing the native callbacks.

patches_modified.name: Earn to Die 2 Remove Google Play Check
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the native Google Play distribution checks (installer package + signing signature) so the app runs when sideloaded.

patches_modified.name: Only One Free Store
patches_modified.description: Makes 'Restore Purchases' grant every store item for free (Ultimate Power, all classes, bundles and powers) — also removes ads.

patches_modified.name: Only One IAP billing bypass
patches_modified.description: Buy any item in the shop for free. When you tap Buy, the item is added to your game right away — no Google Play payment window ever opens.

patches_modified.name: Only One PairIP removal
patches_modified.description: Disables the PairIP license check so the game starts without Google Play licensing, error dialogs or forced exits.

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Edge
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_added.name: Block Ad Server
patches_added.description: Stops Nepali Patro's interstitial ads. Two edits to libapp.so: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length, and AdsBloc::featureInterstitialAdWithHtmlPopup - the single callee behind all 24 interstitial call sites - is forced down its existing 'popup blocked' return, so the full-screen ad page and its countdown never open. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to show the page at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the ad content itself and the AdMob interstitials.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Disables all ad serving from Facebook Audience Network (FAN) and Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). No-ops the plugin bridges so no ads are shown.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables both ad stacks in Nepali Patro: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) and the first-party flutter_adserver HTML ad server. AdMob's method-channel entry point is short-circuited for every load and show call so no ad is ever created, and the three WebView loaders the ad server uses are neutralised - loadData and loadDataWithBaseUrl become no-ops, while loadUrl only refuses the ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np host and data: URLs so normal in-app browsing keeps working.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Disables all ad serving in Hamro Patro by no-oping the native ad-placement resolver (HamroAdsPlacements). Every banner, native, interstitial, fullscreen and roadblock placement funnels through these leaf builders, so returning an empty list means no ad request is ever built for the bundled MAX, Pangle, ironSource, Facebook Audience, Unity, Vungle and Google Ads SDKs, and no mediation cycle ever starts. Re-verified on v10.7.33. Works on its own, and combines cleanly with Nai64's universal No Ads patch if you have it enabled - the two act on different layers, so together they also cover the Google ads_mobile_sdk layer that no SDK-level patch reaches.

patches_modified.description: Block hooked story, profile and typing reports. The switch shows local activity and retains a warning after a known story-reporting failure. patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes, or for any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still work.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps your feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still work.

patches_modified.name: Marketplace only
patches_modified.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead.

patches_modified.name: UI tweaks
patches_modified.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, optionally hide profile sections (recommendations, tools, services, jobs), and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.
patches_modified.previous_description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches_modified.name: Block listings
patches_modified.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.

patches_modified.name: Hide professional sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name and adds MicroG spoofing.

patches_added.name: Flexible Media App Match
patches_added.description: Allows Google Maps to connect to renamed media apps by checking if the package name ends with the expected string rather than an exact match.

patches_added.name: Restore map data
patches_added.description: Lets a re-signed Maps load tiles, search and routing, by sending Google's own package and certificate.

patches_added.name: Block promotional notifications
patches_added.description: Keeps the kinds of notification you pick off your phone, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays. Each kind has its own switch, and they all start off. Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions and login alerts always come through.

patches_added.name: Default comment order
patches_added.description: Opens comments in the order you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. An order you pick in a post's comments stays for that post, and links to a comment still open on it.

patches_added.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches_added.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections of Facebook's Menu. Each has its own switch. Settings, Help and support, your shortcuts and the rest of the Menu stay.

patches_added.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches_added.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts Facebook adds to search results, and stops search suggestions from opening Meta AI by themselves. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still works.

patches_added.name: Hide posts by words
patches_added.description: Hides feed posts whose text has a word or phrase you list, unless it also has one from your keep list. Hushfacebook never sends your words anywhere. The switch starts off, so turn it on and add words in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_added.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_added.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed. Hushfacebook asks Facebook not to send them, and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. The listings people post stay.

patches_added.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches_added.description: Removes the ads between the posts on someone's profile or a Page. The profile's own posts stay.

patches_added.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches_added.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, the sponsored posts and ad cards between the people, pages and posts you searched for.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested stories
patches_added.description: Removes the stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested in the Stories tray. Your friends' stories, the Pages you follow and Create story stay.

patches_added.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches_added.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats while Messenger is installed. Facebook only counts a Messenger signed with its own key, so a re-signed Facebook shows the card even with Messenger right there. Without Messenger the card stays.

patches_added.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches_added.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy. The logo long press and the launcher shortcut still open the settings too.

patches_added.name: Marketplace only
patches_added.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead.

patches_added.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches_added.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick in Hushfacebook's settings when you start it from its icon. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Notifications and links still open where they lead.

patches_added.name: Resume long videos
patches_added.description: A video longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list. Photo tags and your text aren't touched.

patches_added.name: Tap to play
patches_added.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. A tap plays as usual. While its switch is on, Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI. Every switch starts off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. Both switches start off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches_modified.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads: "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know", suggested groups, "Stories you might like", "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too, and so does the "People you may know" row on your own profile. Each kind has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Disables all ad serving in Hamro Patro by no-oping the native ad-placement resolver (HamroAdsPlacements). Every banner, native, interstitial, fullscreen and roadblock placement funnels through these leaf builders, so returning an empty list means no ad request is ever built for the bundled MAX, Pangle, ironSource, Facebook Audience, Unity, Vungle and Google Ads SDKs, and no mediation cycle ever starts. Re-verified on v10.7.33. Works on its own, and combines cleanly with Nai64's universal No Ads patch if you have it enabled - the two act on different layers, so together they also cover the Google ads_mobile_sdk layer that no SDK-level patch reaches.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables all ad serving in Hamro Patro by no-oping the native ad-placement resolver (HamroAdsPlacements). Every banner, native, interstitial, fullscreen and roadblock placement funnels through these leaf builders, so returning an empty list means no ad request is ever built for AdMob, Pangle, IronSource or Facebook Audience Network. Verified on v10.7.30.

patches_added.name: Block Ad Server
patches_added.description: Stops Nepali Patro's interstitial ads. Two edits to libapp.so: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length, and AdsBloc::featureInterstitialAdWithHtmlPopup - the single callee behind all 24 interstitial call sites - is forced down its existing 'popup blocked' return, so the full-screen ad page and its countdown never open. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to show the page at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the ad content itself and the AdMob interstitials.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Disables both ad stacks in Nepali Patro: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) and the first-party flutter_adserver HTML ad server. AdMob's method-channel entry point is short-circuited for every load and show call so no ad is ever created, and the WebView loaders the ad server uses are neutralised - loadData and loadDataWithBaseUrl become no-ops, while loadUrl only refuses the ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np host and data: URLs so normal in-app browsing keeps working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables all ad serving from Facebook Audience Network (FAN) and Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). No-ops the plugin bridges so no ads are shown.

patches_added.name: Disable audio ads
patches_added.description: Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.

patches_added.name: Remove popup promos
patches_added.description: No-ops the in-house popup funnel, the fullscreen startup dialog, and the flyer ad callback. Google SDK ads untouched.

patches_added.name: Unlock downloads
patches_added.description: No-ops download limit asserts, forces limited-plan=false and large offline caps (999999). Local gates only; the server still authorizes files.

patches_added.name: Unlock playback limits
patches_added.description: Disables skip and queue limits (skipLimitReached/queueRestrictionsEnabled=false, disable-flags=true). Local gates only.

patches_removed.name: Remove ads

patches_removed.name: Unlock playback/download restrictions
patches_removed.description: Forces skip/queue limits off, download asserts no-op, limited-plan false, noAd true, max offline 999999. Local gates only.

patches_modified.name: Hide upgrade upsell

patches_added.name: Power saving mode
patches_added.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Customization > Power saving mode is turned on.

patches_added.name: 120 refresh rate
patches_added.description: Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization screen.

patches_added.description: Hides the Follow button on reels and the comment and reaction previews under them. Buttons such as Remix, Use template, Add yours and Stars go too, and each part has its own switch.

patches_added.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_added.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched. It's used to rank your Reels feed, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back in the feed.

patches_added.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches_added.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install beside the patched Facebook. Facebook shares two permissions with them, and Android lets only one signing key own a permission, so this patch renames Facebook's. A Root Mount install doesn't need it.

patches_added.name: Stop update prompts
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook's own update prompts on a patched build, which can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update promotions and the push message that has it look for an update go, and so do chat promotions aimed at older versions.

patches_added.name: Use the system font

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Adds a network_security_config trusting user CAs (no pin sets) so AdGuard Premium can inspect the app's platform-stack HTTPS. Optional adjunct: removes no ads by itself and is not needed for the native in-app ad strip. Opt-in. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA, so leave it off unless you run an HTTPS-filtering proxy.

Blocking happens on the device, inside the app. Crash reporting, feature flags, sign-in and playback are left alone. Recommendations may be less personalised. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
