Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. A short list of creator exceptions lets chosen accounts through the filters on the kind of post, its labels, age, length and counts. Ads, blocked creators, words, sounds and countries, paid and Shop content, LIVE and seen videos still apply to them. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded and the ads a creator's video pager asks for on its own. The share prompt that appears after a like can be hidden too, and so can TikTok Shop's Products block and product cards in search results. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, can hide the Following and For You names above the feed while swiping between them keeps working, can hide the Tako AI bubble and the unread badges on the bottom tabs, can keep For You from reloading on a Home tap or a pull down, brings TikTok's LIVE button back to the feed's corner when the LIVE tab is taken off either bar, can open TikTok on Following, Friends, Inbox or Profile, and can show TikTok's own feed buttons without a screen reader. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Puts the whole of a vertical video on screen instead of cropping it to the window. On a 9:16 phone nothing changes, because the video already fills it. On a Fold opened up, a squarer phone or a split view the sides or the ends stop being cut off. A second switch, Fill the screen with the video, does the opposite and crops the video until it covers the screen, for the phones where TikTok leaves a black strip under a 9:16 video. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: Shows comments beside the video on windows wider than a configurable threshold. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Reads what the server said about a follow. A follow TikTok turns down comes back looking like a success, so this reports the refusal and its reason once per session and, with diagnostic logging on, writes the whole exchange to the report.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stop TikTok reporting that you viewed a story or a profile or that you are typing. Online status is unchanged. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide the CAPTCHA dialogs raised while browsing or watching LIVE. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any CAPTCHA the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Gives the patched APK the highest Android version code so Play shows Open instead of Update. TikTok's visible version stays the same in Morphe Manager. Off by default. Android won't install a lower-code APK over it, and uninstalling to return to a lower code can remove local TikTok data.
patches_modified.previous_description: Gives the patched APK the highest Android version code so Play shows Open instead of Update. TikTok's visible version stays 47.0.3 in Morphe Manager. Off by default. Android won't install a lower-code APK over it, and uninstalling to return to a lower code can remove local TikTok data.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Keeps a local record of the videos you have watched and hides them when the feed sends them again. The record never leaves the device and can be cleared from settings. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that plays over the comment sheet when a comment matches an advertiser's trigger word or emoji. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides automatic emoji and sticker suggestions above the comment box. Manual buttons stay available. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds. Shares its switch with the LIVE entrance option of Hide video overlays, and stops the button before it is built rather than hiding it once it is on screen. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Hide the save button from video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Hide the search button at the top right of video feeds. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges from the feed and can hide the rewards shortcut on Profile. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen and App.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the stories tray at the top of the Inbox and restores it immediately when the switch is turned off. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone. A separate switch hides the search rewards banner and coin counter some regions get. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages, and collapses every other People you may like card: the profile header, the Friends tab and the feed. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that opens on pressing and holding TikTok's icon on the home screen. The entries are built while the app runs rather than declared in it, and TikTok only rewrites them when it notices a difference, so this removes what is already published and answers the handover that would publish more. Turning it off asks TikTok to build them again. Tapping the icon still opens the app, and a shortcut pinned to a home screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's own hold, pull down and release gesture to lock the hold speed, 2x unless Playback speed sets another. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Keeps TikTok's JavaScript bridge off external pages in its in-app browser while leaving Activity center, Watch history, shop checkout and CAPTCHA working. The switch is off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab on your profile when TikTok's server puts the account into an experiment that empties it. Two people saw that after patching: the tab was there and the saved videos were not. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate and skips its push initialization task. Videos may start buffering later, and TikTok push notifications may stop.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Answers TikTok's location requests with nothing: the last known location comes back empty and update requests never fire. The SIM and region spoof change the locale and timezone, not the coordinates. This patch stops the coordinates. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, copy the link to the video or its sound, or look the sound up on YouTube Music. It can also turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward, and make a long press on Comment, Share or Favorites play at the hold speed instead of opening TikTok's menu. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok's own API client sends, by domain and kind, and adds them to the diagnostic export. Video and image downloads and other companies' SDKs keep their own connections and aren't counted. Nothing about the requests is changed.

patches_modified.name: Not interested button
patches_modified.description: Adds a movable button that tells TikTok you aren't interested in the current video. It hides while comments are open. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. The follower switch drops the notification before Android is asked to post it, so nothing else in the drawer is affected. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Selects the lowest, highest or a target video quality for playback, adaptive streams included. A second choice caps quality on mobile data and only ever lowers it. Download quality has its own setting. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers playback speed or applies a default to each new video, with custom menu choices up to 3x and your own speed for the hold gesture. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Matches locale, timezone and native region getters to the SIM preset, with a separate experimental store-region switch. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers clear display between videos, or enters it automatically after a chosen delay. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA and Microblink card-scanning assets, the Pitaya AI model libraries, the live-cast dynamic feature, and the ART log monitor probe.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. The Create tab and all recording, editing and effects tools stop working. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, records a repost request, TikTok's answer, and the next repost-list read without recording the video's ID or note.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok listening to the motion sensors it polls for device fingerprinting: the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, rotation, gravity and linear acceleration sensors. Saves the battery they wake. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared, and can put a host of your choosing in place of tiktok.com. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings screen to TikTok and keeps its entry first in Settings and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Asks twice before a video is sent to a friend from the share sheet. The check follows the account or conversation instead of the visible name and covers accessibility actions and keyboard input. It can also hide chosen people, share options or the whole Send to row, and a profile's or a LIVE's share sheet can hide a different set from a video's. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the LIVE drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Show the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name on the feed. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden, including when one of TikTok's experiments takes it off every video but paid content. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's splash-ad preload tasks and returns false from its reviewed splash and TopView gates. Other startup behavior is left in place.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's background and boot-finished device-ID update-check tasks. This may suppress some in-app update checks. Play Store updates are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Kills the Pitaya on-device ML inference engine at startup so it cannot build a behavioral profile. The AI asset strip in the core de-bloat patch removes the native libraries. This patch stops the initialization code that would download replacements.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Saves subtitle files beside downloaded videos and adds caption size, background, and clear-display options. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a feed video do nothing or open its comments instead of opening the creator's profile. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws TikTok's text in your device's font instead of TikTok Sans. The icons, the gift animations and the @ and # glyphs keep their own fonts. Off by default. Restart after changing. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable Pro
patches_modified.description: Suppresses the main byAir paywall, unlock banners, local user gating, and the notifications preferences "All" gate.
patches_modified.previous_description: Suppresses the main byAir paywall, unlock banners, and local user gating.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is a local 'is_premium' SharedPreferences flag (in the 'rawcam_prefs' file) read on cold start into a StateFlow. Unlocks RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, custom boosted modes and the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. It also neutralizes PairIP's Play Store licensing (fired from both Application.attachBaseContext and LicenseContentProvider.onCreate, so a repacked copy no longer gets bounced to the Play Store paywall at launch).

patches_added.name: Unlock Edge
patches_added.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written only by PurchaseManager.d(Z); every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static MasterProGate.K(). The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Disables both ad stacks in Nepali Patro: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) and the first-party flutter_adserver HTML ad server. AdMob's method-channel entry point is short-circuited for every load and show call so no ad is ever created, and the three WebView loaders the ad server uses are neutralised - loadData and loadDataWithBaseUrl become no-ops, while loadUrl only refuses the ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np host and data: URLs so normal in-app browsing keeps working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables all ad serving from Facebook Audience Network (FAN) and Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). No-ops the plugin bridges so no ads are shown.

patches_modified.description: Reconnects the moment you come back to the app, instead of leaving you on a countdown that grows to eight seconds. While an article is open it waits until you leave it or do something that needs PTT, so opening links does not log you in again every time.

patches_added.name: Comment send fix
patches_added.description: Sends comments TikTok would drop without a word. TikTok checks a send against the most recently opened page, and when that page has already lost its screen it stops the comment and shows nothing. This checks it against the comment panel's own screen instead.

patches_added.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_added.description: With diagnostic logging on, records a repost request, TikTok's answer, and the next repost-list read without recording the video's ID or note.

patches_added.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_added.description: Gives the patched APK the highest Android version code so Play shows Open instead of Update. TikTok's visible version stays 47.0.3 in Morphe Manager. Off by default. Android won't install a lower-code APK over it, and uninstalling to return to a lower code can remove local TikTok data.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Adds a network_security_config trusting user CAs (no pin sets) so AdGuard Premium can inspect the app's platform-stack HTTPS. Optional adjunct: removes no ads by itself and is not needed for the native in-app ad strip. Opt-in. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA, so leave it off unless you run an HTTPS-filtering proxy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a network_security_config trusting user CAs (no pin sets) so AdGuard Premium can inspect the app's platform-stack HTTPS. Optional adjunct: Prime Video's ad plane is largely native libcurl, so DNS blocking is the primary tool.

patches_added.name: Block analytics & tracking
patches_added.description: Stops Tubi's analytics and tracking: Adjust, Branch, Braze, Nielsen, Conviva, NPAW/Youbora, Mux, Firebase/Google Analytics, Meta app events, and Tubi's own analytics endpoint (which receives your advertiser ID, device ID and ZIP/location fields). Blocking happens on the device, inside the app. Crash reporting, feature flags, sign-in and playback are left alone. Recommendations may be less personalised. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables ViX live (Lura SSAI) ad suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA; turn it off if you don't use an HTTPS-filtering proxy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables ViX live (Lura SSAI) ad suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Edits Pluto's network_security_config to trust user CAs (system + user, overridePins) on both a new base-config and every existing domain-config — including the pluto.tv entry that is otherwise system-only — so an HTTPS-filtering proxy can inspect the HLS manifest. Optional adjunct: removes no ads by itself and is not needed for the in-app ad removal. Opt-in. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA, so leave it off unless you run an HTTPS-filtering proxy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Edits Pluto's network_security_config to trust user CAs (system + user, overridePins) on both a new base-config and every existing domain-config — including the pluto.tv entry that is otherwise system-only — so an HTTPS-filtering proxy can inspect the HLS manifest. Optional adjunct to the manifest-rewrite ad approach.

patches_added.name: Ad-Free & Hide Upgrade Popups - Canva (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Strips in-editor upgrade dialogs, Pro upsell cards in template galleries, subscription CTAs on element detail drawers, and interstitial purchase popups throughout Canva.

patches_added.name: Remove Watermarks on Free Elements - Canva (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Bypasses watermark rendering on Canva freemium design elements, stock photos, and templates, allowing clean export of designs without Pro subscription watermarks.

patches_added.name: Unlimited Brand Kit Slots - Canva (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Removes the Brand Kit slot limit, allowing unlimited custom color palettes, font sets, and logo libraries without a Canva Pro or Teams subscription.

patches_added.name: Unlock Canva Pro Features (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks Canva Pro premium templates, exclusive fonts, advanced design elements, and premium content library without an active Pro subscription.

patches_added.name: Bypass Storage Quota Alerts - Google Drive (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Suppresses storage quota threshold alerts, 15 GB full warnings, and upload-blocking dialogs that prevent uploading new files when Google storage is at or near its limit.

patches_added.name: Force Dark Theme System-Wide - Google Drive (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Forces pure OLED dark theme (#000000) across all Google Drive screens including file browser, folder views, sharing dialogs, and document detail drawers regardless of system theme.

patches_added.name: Remove Ads & Promotional Banners - Google Drive (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Removes Google One upsell banners, Workspace promotional cards, storage upgrade prompts, and sponsored suggestions from the Drive home feed and search results.

patches_added.name: Unlock Offline Mode Without WiFi - Google Drive (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Forces Google Drive offline sync and file access to work on mobile data connections by bypassing the WiFi-only restriction enforced during offline content synchronization.

patches_added.name: Unlock PDF Editor & Advanced Sharing - Google Drive (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks inline PDF editing, annotation tools, advanced link-sharing permission levels, and extended expiry options for shared files without a Workspace subscription.

patches_added.name: Bypass Download Restrictions - Movix (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Bypasses offline download tier restrictions to allow downloading any movie or series episode for offline viewing without a Premium subscription, and removes download quality caps.

patches_added.name: Disable Auto-Pause on Background - Movix (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Prevents Movix from automatically pausing or stopping video playback when the app transitions to the background, enabling audio-only listening and uninterrupted casting.

patches_added.name: Force HD & 4K Quality Unlock - Movix (Experimental)
patches_added.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Forces maximum available video quality (HD 1080p / 4K) on all content regardless of subscription tier or network quality detection thresholds.

patches_added.name: Unlock Premium Subscription - Movix (Experimental)

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches_modified.name: Exit fullscreen mode
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically exit fullscreen mode when a video reaches the end.

patches_modified.name: Force fullscreen landscape
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices.

patches_modified.name: Force original audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches_modified.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches_modified.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Hide Shorts components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen suggested video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide info cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide layout components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches_modified.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches_modified.name: Hide related video overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: Hide related videos
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide timestamp
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide video action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches_modified.name: Loop video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Media notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches_modified.name: Mute button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches_modified.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches_modified.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_modified.name: Play all
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Playback in feeds
patches_modified.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Reload video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation
patches_modified.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_added.name: Comment sort controls
patches_added.description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.

patches_added.name: Enable voice comments
patches_added.description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_added.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_added.description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_added.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_added.description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.

patches_added.name: Hide AI content
patches_added.description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.

patches_added.name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos
patches_added.description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.

patches_added.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed save button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed search button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_added.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.

patches_added.name: Region spoof
patches_added.description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.

patches_added.name: Share sheet modification
patches_added.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_removed.name: SIM spoof
patches_removed.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds diagnostic logging, crash capture, reports, and an optional rolling feed debugger.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local TikTok crash capture.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.
patches_modified.previous_description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches_added.name: Power saving mode
patches_added.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Customization > Power saving mode is turned on.

patches_added.name: Unlock Premium Plus
patches_added.description: Unlocks HD up to original quality, playback speeds up to 3x and video uploads. HD buffers faster over parallel connections.

patches_modified.description: Hides Premium upgrade cards and banners, prize and campaign cards, speed-up prompts, floating invites, and sale, coupon and promotional popups.

patches_added.name: Custom accent color
patches_added.description: Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.
